sentences.zh: 流隕四

translations.literal: Shooting Stars IV
translations.idiomatic: Shooting Stars IV

sentences.zh: 建中靖國元年正月癸亥，星出西南，如盂，東北急流，入尾距星沒，青黑，無尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: First year of Jianzhong Jingguo, first month, day guihai—a star emerged in the southwest, like a bowl, flowing swiftly northeast, entering and vanishing at the Tail's spaced star, blue-black, without a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of the Jianzhong Jingguo era, on the day guihai, a star as large as a bowl appeared in the southwest, streaked swiftly northeast, and vanished at the spaced star of the Tail; it was blue-black, left no tail-trail, and shone brightly enough to light the ground.

sentences.zh: 崇甯元年三月庚辰，星出張，如金星，西南急流，至濁沒，赤黃，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: First year of Chongning, third month, day gengchen—a star emerged from the Spread, like Venus, flowing swiftly southwest, vanishing at the Turbid, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of the Chongning era, on the day gengchen, a star like Venus appeared from the Spread, streaked swiftly southwest, and vanished at the Turbid; it was red-yellow, had a tail-trail, and its light lit the ground.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，星出尾，如杯，西南慢流，入濁沒，青白，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingmao—a star emerged from the Tail, like a cup, flowing slowly southwest, entering and vanishing at the Turbid, blue-white, with a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day dingmao, a star as large as a cup appeared from the Tail, drifted slowly southwest, and vanished in the Turbid; it was blue-white, had a tail-trail, and shone brightly enough to illuminate the ground.

sentences.zh: 閏六月癸酉，星出鬥，向西南慢流，至建沒，青白，有尾跡，數小星從之。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, day guiyou—a star emerged from the Dipper, flowing slowly toward the southwest, vanishing at Jian, blue-white, with a tail-trail, several small stars following it.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month, on the day guiyou, a star appeared from the Dipper and drifted slowly southwest until it vanished at Jian; it was blue-white, had a tail-trail, and was followed by several smaller stars.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，星出羽林軍，如杯，急流至濁沒，青白，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiwei—a star emerged from the Feathered Forest Army, like a cup, flowing swiftly to vanish at the Turbid, blue-white, with a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day jiwei, a star as large as a cup appeared from the Feathered Forest Army, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the Turbid; it was blue-white, had a tail-trail, and its light lit the ground.

sentences.zh: 十月壬子，星出天船，如盂，急流至五車沒，青黑，有尾跡，聲隆隆然。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day renzi—a star emerged from the Celestial Boat, like a bowl, flowing swiftly to vanish at the Five Chariots, blue-black, with a tail-trail, its sound rumbling.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day renzi, a star as large as a bowl appeared from the Celestial Boat, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the Five Chariots; it was blue-black, had a tail-trail, and made a rumbling sound.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯，星出婁，如金星，西南慢流，至外屏沒，赤黃，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jimao—a star emerged from the Bond, like Venus, flowing slowly southwest, vanishing at the Outer Screen, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day jimao, a star like Venus appeared from the Bond and drifted slowly southwest until it vanished at the Outer Screen; it was red-yellow, had a tail-trail, and shone brightly enough to light the ground.

sentences.zh: 二年正月戊申，星出未位，如金星，急流至北河沒，青白，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Second year, first month, day wushen—a star emerged from the Wei station, like Venus, flowing swiftly to vanish at the North River, blue-white, with a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year, on the day wushen, a star like Venus appeared from the Wei station, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the North River; it was blue-white, had a tail-trail, and its light lit the ground.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，星出亢，如金星，西南急流，入濁沒，赤黃，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuwu—a star emerged from the Neck, like Venus, flowing swiftly southwest, entering and vanishing at the Turbid, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，星出大陵，如金星，至騰蛇沒，赤黃，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingwei—a star emerged from the Great Tomb, like Venus, vanishing at the Flying Serpent, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day dingwei, a star like Venus appeared from the Great Tomb and vanished at the Flying Serpent; it was red-yellow, had a tail-trail, and its light lit the ground.

sentences.zh: 三年四月戊申，星出軫，如杯，西北慢流，入太微垣內屏星沒，赤黃，有尾跡，明燭地；

translations.literal: Third year, fourth month, day wushen—a star emerged from the Axletree, like a cup, flowing slowly northwest, entering and vanishing at the Screen star within the Supreme Palace Enclosure, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground;

sentences.zh: 又入太微；

translations.literal: it again entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure;
translations.idiomatic: it entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure again;

sentences.zh: 又入屏星。

translations.literal: it again entered the Screen star.
translations.idiomatic: and entered the Screen star again.

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingwu—a star emerged from the Root, like Venus, flowing slowly northeast, entering the Celestial Market Enclosure, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day bingwu, a star like Venus appeared from the Root, drifted slowly northeast, and entered the Celestial Market Enclosure; it was red-yellow, had a tail-trail, and its light lit the ground.

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiyou—a star emerged from Jian, like a cup, flowing swiftly southwest, vanishing at the Turtle, blue-white, with a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day jiyou, a star as large as a cup appeared from Jian, streaked swiftly southwest, and vanished at the Turtle; it was blue-white, had a tail-trail, and shone brightly enough to illuminate the ground.

translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day jiazi, a star as large as a bowl appeared from the Celestial Great General, streaked swiftly northwest, and vanished at Wang Liang; it was red-yellow, left no tail-trail, and its light lit the ground.

translations.literal: Fourth year, first month, day jiashen—a star emerged from the Horn, like a bowl, flowing slowly southwest, entering and vanishing at the Turbid, blue-white, without a tail-trail.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, on the day jiashen, a star as large as a bowl appeared from the Horn, drifted slowly southwest, and vanished in the Turbid; it was blue-white and left no tail-trail.

translations.literal: Third month, day gengzi—a star emerged from the Canopy of the Purple Palace Enclosure, like a cup, vanishing at the great star of Gouchen, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day gengzi, a star as large as a cup appeared from the Canopy of the Purple Palace Enclosure and vanished at the great star of Gouchen; it was red-yellow, had a tail-trail, and its light lit the ground.

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengshen—a star emerged from the River Drum, like a bowl, flowing swiftly northwest, entering and vanishing at the Turbid, blue-white, with a tail-trail; twelfth month, day jiawu—a star emerged from the Triaster, like a cup, flowing slowly southeast, entering and vanishing at the Military Market, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day gengshen, a star as large as a bowl appeared from the River Drum, streaked swiftly northwest, and vanished in the Turbid; it was blue-white and had a tail-trail. In the twelfth month, on the day jiawu, a star as large as a cup appeared from the Triaster, drifted slowly southeast, and vanished at the Military Market; it was red-yellow, had a tail-trail, and shone brightly enough to light the ground.

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifth year, on the day gengwu, a star like Venus appeared from the Western Shaman, streaked swiftly northeast, and vanished inside the Celestial Market Enclosure; it was blue-white, had a tail-trail, and its light lit the ground.

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yiyou—a star emerged from the Arsenal Tower, like a cup, flowing swiftly west, entering and vanishing at the Turbid, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day yiyou, a star as large as a cup appeared from the Arsenal Tower, streaked swiftly westward, and vanished in the Turbid; it was red-yellow, had a tail-trail, and shone brightly enough to illuminate the ground.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，星出天船，如杯，慢流至諸王沒，青白，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guimao—a star emerged from the Celestial Boat, like a cup, flowing slowly to vanish at the Various Lords, blue-white, with a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day guimao, a star as large as a cup appeared from the Celestial Boat, drifted slowly, and vanished at the Various Lords; it was blue-white, had a tail-trail, and its light lit the ground.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬戌，星出奎，向南急流，入天倉沒，青白，有尾跡及三丈，明燭地，聲散如裂帛。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renxu—a star emerged from the Stride, flowing swiftly south, entering and vanishing at the Celestial Granary, blue-white, with a tail-trail more than three zhang, its brightness illuminating the ground, its sound scattering like tearing silk.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day renxu, a star appeared from the Stride, streaked swiftly south, and vanished at the Celestial Granary; it was blue-white, had a tail-trail more than thirty feet long, shone brightly enough to light the ground, and its sound scattered like ripping silk.

sentences.zh: 大觀元年二月丁卯，星出參，如杯，西南急流，入濁沒，赤黃，無尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: First year of Daguan, second month, day dingmao—a star emerged from the Triaster, like a cup, flowing swiftly southwest, entering and vanishing at the Turbid, red-yellow, without a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground.

translations.literal: Fourth month, day xinwei—a star emerged from the Axletree, like a bowl, flowing slowly south, entering and vanishing at the Turbid, blue-white, with a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the day xinwei, a star as large as a bowl appeared from the Axletree, drifted slowly southward, and vanished in the Turbid; it was blue-white, had a tail-trail, and its light lit the ground.

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day yihai, a star as large as a cup appeared southwest of the Tail, drifted slowly southwest, and vanished in the Turbid; it was blue-white, had a tail-trail, and shone brightly enough to illuminate the ground.

translations.literal: Seventh month, day gengxu—a star emerged from the Winnowing Basket, like a cup, flowing swiftly southwest, entering and vanishing at the Turbid, red-yellow, without a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the day gengxu, a star as large as a cup appeared from the Winnowing Basket, streaked swiftly southwest, and vanished in the Turbid; it was red-yellow, left no tail-trail, and lit the ground brightly.

sentences.zh: 二年十二月癸卯，星出奎，如盂，西北急流，入造父沒，赤黃，有尾跡，照地明，有聲。

translations.literal: Second year, twelfth month, day guimao—a star emerged from the Stride, like a bowl, flowing swiftly northwest, entering and vanishing at Zaofu, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year, on the day guimao, a star as large as a bowl appeared from the Stride, streaked swiftly northwest, and vanished at Zaofu; it was red-yellow, had a tail-trail, lit the ground brightly, and made a sound.

sentences.zh: 政和元年四月丙辰，星出亢，如盂，西北急流，至右攝提沒，赤黃，有尾跡，照地明。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinsi—before the sun had reached mid-heaven, a star fell in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day xinsi, before the sun had reached its zenith, a star fell in the southeast.

translations.literal: Fourth year, ninth month, day gengzi—a star emerged from the Tomb, like a bowl, flowing swiftly southeast, entering and vanishing at the Feathered Forest Army, blue-white, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly.

translations.literal: Seventh year, twelfth month, day jiazi—a star emerged southeast of the Stomach, like a bowl, flowing swiftly northwest, vanishing at the Celestial Great General, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly.

translations.literal: Fourth year, eleventh month, day bingyin—a star emerged north of Wang Liang, like a cup, flowing swiftly to vanish north of the Upper Assistant within the Purple Palace Enclosure, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fourth year, on the day bingyin, a star as large as a cup appeared north of Wang Liang, streaked swiftly, and vanished north of the Upper Assistant inside the Purple Palace Enclosure; it was red-yellow, had a tail-trail, and lit the ground brightly.

sentences.zh: 五年二月丙午，星出北河東北，如杯，東南慢流，至軫沒，赤黃，有尾跡，照地明。

translations.literal: Fifth year, second month, day bingwu—a star emerged northeast of the North River, like a cup, flowing slowly southeast, vanishing at the Axletree, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fifth year, on the day bingwu, a star as large as a cup appeared northeast of the North River, drifted slowly southeast, and vanished at the Axletree; it was red-yellow, had a tail-trail, and lit the ground brightly.

sentences.zh: 六年七月丁酉，星出太陽守，如盂，東北急流，入濁沒，赤黃，有尾跡，照地明。

translations.literal: Sixth year, seventh month, day dingyou—a star emerged from the Solar Sentinel, like a bowl, flowing swiftly northeast, entering and vanishing at the Turbid, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the sixth year, on the day dingyou, a star as large as a bowl appeared from the Solar Sentinel, streaked swiftly northeast, and vanished in the Turbid; it was red-yellow, had a tail-trail, and lit the ground brightly.

sentences.zh: 七年十一月戊子，星出王良北，如杯，急流入紫微垣上輔北，赤黃，有尾跡，照地明。

translations.literal: Seventh year, eleventh month, day wuzi—a star emerged north of Wang Liang, like a cup, flowing swiftly into the area north of the Upper Assistant in the Purple Palace Enclosure, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the seventh year, on the day wuzi, a star as large as a cup appeared north of Wang Liang, streaked swiftly to the region north of the Upper Assistant in the Purple Palace Enclosure; it was red-yellow, had a tail-trail, and lit the ground brightly.

sentences.zh: 建炎四年六月乙酉，星出紫微垣鉤陳。

translations.literal: Fourth year of Jianyan, sixth month, day yiyou—a star emerged from Gouchen in the Purple Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourth year of the Jianyan era, on the day yiyou, a star appeared from Gouchen in the Purple Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 十月辛未，星出壁。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day xinwei—a star emerged from the Wall.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day xinwei, a star appeared from the Wall.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年四月甲戌，星出東方，晝隕。

translations.literal: First year of Shaoxing, fourth month, day jiaxu—a star emerged in the east and fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of the Shaoxing era, on the day jiaxu, a star appeared in the east and fell during the day.

sentences.zh: 七月乙未朔，星出河鼓。

translations.literal: Seventh month, first day of the month yimao—a star emerged from the River Drum.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month, the day yimao, a star appeared from the River Drum.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，星出羽林軍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinwei—a star emerged from the Feathered Forest Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day xinwei, a star appeared from the Feathered Forest Army.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，星出婁宿西南。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengxu—a star emerged southwest of the Bond lodge.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day gengxu, a star appeared southwest of the Bond.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，星出天槍北。

translations.literal: Day dingsi—a star emerged north of the Celestial Spear.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi, a star appeared north of the Celestial Spear.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子朔，星出大陵西北。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, first day of the month jiazi—a star emerged northwest of the Great Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month, the day jiazi, a star appeared northwest of the Great Tomb.

sentences.zh: 二年三月甲午，星出紫微垣華蓋西南。

translations.literal: Second year, third month, day jiawu—a star emerged southwest of the Canopy of the Purple Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year, on the day jiawu, a star appeared southwest of the Canopy of the Purple Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，星出角。

translations.literal: Day yimao—a star emerged from the Horn.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao, a star appeared from the Horn.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，星出紫微垣右樞星。

translations.literal: Day dingsi—a star emerged from the Right Pivot star of the Purple Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi, a star appeared from the Right Pivot star of the Purple Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 戊午，星出軒轅大星西南。

translations.literal: Day wuwu—a star emerged southwest of the great star of the Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu, a star appeared southwest of the great star of the Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: 閏四月乙巳，星出太微垣西右執法北。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, day yisi—a star emerged north of the Right Enforcer west of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month, on the day yisi, a star appeared north of the Right Enforcer on the west side of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未，星出河鼓。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guiwei—a star emerged from the River Drum.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day guiwei, a star appeared from the River Drum.

sentences.zh: 五年十月壬戌，星出室東南，赤黃而大。

translations.literal: Fifth year, tenth month, day renxu—a star emerged southeast of the Encampment, red-yellow and large.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fifth year, on the day renxu, a star appeared southeast of the Encampment; it was red-yellow and unusually large.

sentences.zh: 六年十月壬子，星出壁西北。

translations.literal: Sixth year, tenth month, day renzi—a star emerged northwest of the Wall.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the sixth year, on the day renzi, a star appeared northwest of the Wall.

sentences.zh: 七年八月壬寅，星隕於汴。

translations.literal: Seventh year, eighth month, day renyin—a star fell at Bian.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the seventh year, on the day renyin, a star fell at Bian.

sentences.zh: 八年十一月乙巳，星出天囷東北。

translations.literal: Eighth year, eleventh month, day yisi—a star emerged northeast of the Celestial Granary.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the eighth year, on the day yisi, a star appeared northeast of the Celestial Granary.

sentences.zh: 九年五月癸未，星出房宿東南。

translations.literal: Ninth year, fifth month, day guiwei—a star emerged southeast of the Room lodge.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the ninth year, on the day guiwei, a star appeared southeast of the Room.

sentences.zh: 十七年八月己未，星出危宿，慢流至貫索沒，青白色，有尾跡，照地明，大如太白，二十六年六月丁亥，星出東北方，光明照地。

translations.literal: Seventeenth year, eighth month, day jiwei—a star emerged from the Rooftop lodge, flowing slowly to vanish at the Coiled Thong, blue-white, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly, as large as the Great White; twenty-sixth year, sixth month, day dinghai—a star emerged in the northeast, its brilliance illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the seventeenth year, on the day jiwei, a star appeared from the Rooftop, drifted slowly, and vanished at the Coiled Thong; it was blue-white, had a tail-trail, lit the ground brightly, and was as large as Venus. In the sixth month of the twenty-sixth year, on the day dinghai, a star appeared in the northeast, its light shining on the ground.

sentences.zh: 二十八年六月戊戌，星晝隕，有尾長三丈，至西北沒。

translations.literal: Twenty-eighth year, sixth month, day wuxu—a star fell in daylight, with a tail more than three zhang long, vanishing in the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-eighth year, on the day wuxu, a star fell during the day; its tail was more than thirty feet long, and it vanished in the northwest.

sentences.zh: 二十九年八月戊寅，星出紫微垣西南，約長三尺，赤黃色，西南急流，至鉤陳大星東北沒。

translations.literal: Twenty-ninth year, eighth month, day wuyin—a star emerged southwest of the Purple Palace Enclosure, approximately three chi in length, red-yellow in color, flowing swiftly southwest, vanishing northeast of the great star of Gouchen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-ninth year, on the day wuyin, a star about three feet long appeared southwest of the Purple Palace Enclosure; it was red-yellow, streaked swiftly southwest, and vanished northeast of the great star of Gouchen.

sentences.zh: 三十一年六月乙卯，星出右攝提，赤白色，急流向東南沒，有尾跡，大如歲星。

translations.literal: Thirty-first year, sixth month, day yimao—a star emerged from the Right Conductor, red-white in color, flowing swiftly to vanish in the southeast, with a tail-trail, as large as the Year Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the thirty-first year, on the day yimao, a star appeared from the Right Conductor; it was red-white, streaked swiftly southeast and vanished, had a tail-trail, and was as large as Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，星出，青白色，自東北急流向東南沒，有尾跡，大如盞口。

translations.literal: Day dingsi—a star emerged, blue-white in color, flowing swiftly from the northeast to vanish in the southeast, with a tail-trail, as large as a bowl rim.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi, a star appeared; it was blue-white, streaked swiftly from the northeast to the southeast and vanished, had a tail-trail, and was as large as a bowl rim.

sentences.zh: 甲子，星出氐，赤黃色，慢流至角宿天田沒，初小後大，如太白，後有小星隨之。

translations.literal: Day jiazi—a star emerged from the Root, red-yellow in color, flowing slowly to vanish at the Celestial Field of the Horn lodge, small at first then large, like the Great White, afterward small stars following it.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi, a star appeared from the Root; it was red-yellow, drifted slowly, and vanished at the Celestial Field of the Horn, starting small and growing large like Venus, with smaller stars following behind.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，星晝隕，約長三丈。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renwu—a star fell in daylight, approximately three zhang in length.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day renwu, a star fell during the day; it was about thirty feet long.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年六月丁丑，星出尾宿，青白色，向東南慢流沒。

translations.literal: First year of Longxing, sixth month, day dingchou—a star emerged from the Tail lodge, blue-white in color, flowing slowly toward the southeast and vanishing.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of the Longxing era, on the day dingchou, a star appeared from the Tail; it was blue-white and drifted slowly southeast until it vanished.

sentences.zh: 七月壬寅，星出天市垣內，赤色，向西北慢流，至右攝提西南沒，炸散小星二十餘顆，有聲，尾跡大如太白，丙午，又出天市垣，慢流至氐宿沒，青白色，微有尾跡，小如填星。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day renyin—a star emerged within the Celestial Market Enclosure, red in color, flowing slowly northwest, vanishing southwest of the Right Conductor, bursting and scattering more than twenty small stars, with sound, its tail-trail as large as the Great White; day bingwu—it again emerged from the Celestial Market Enclosure, flowing slowly to vanish at the Root lodge, blue-white, slightly with a tail-trail, as small as the Filling Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the day renyin, a star appeared inside the Celestial Market Enclosure; it was red, drifted slowly northwest, and vanished southwest of the Right Conductor, bursting into more than twenty smaller stars with a sound; its tail-trail was as large as Venus. On the day bingwu another star appeared from the Celestial Market Enclosure, drifted slowly, and vanished at the Root; it was blue-white, had a slight tail-trail, and was as small as Saturn.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，星出織女，急流向貫索西北沒，青白色，明大如土星，照地。

translations.literal: Day guichou—a star emerged from the Weaving Maid, flowing swiftly to vanish northwest of the Coiled Thong, blue-white, bright and large like the Earth Star, illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou, a star appeared from the Weaving Maid, streaked swiftly, and vanished northwest of the Coiled Thong; it was blue-white, as bright and large as Saturn, and lit the ground.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，星出輦道，急流入天棓西南沒，赤黃色，有尾跡，小如土星。

translations.literal: Day bingchen—a star emerged from the Imperial Road, flowing swiftly to vanish southwest of the Celestial Club, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, as small as the Earth Star.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen, a star appeared from the Imperial Road, streaked swiftly, and vanished southwest of the Celestial Club; it was red-yellow, had a tail-trail, and was as small as Saturn.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，星出羽林軍，赤黃色，向東南急流，至濁沒。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengshen—a star emerged from the Feathered Forest Army, red-yellow in color, flowing swiftly toward the southeast, vanishing at the Turbid.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day gengshen, a star appeared from the Feathered Forest Army; it was red-yellow, streaked swiftly southeast, and vanished at the Turbid.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，星出虛宿，赤黃色，急流至牛宿西南沒。

translations.literal: Day wuchen—a star emerged from the Emptiness lodge, red-yellow in color, flowing swiftly to vanish southwest of the Ox lodge.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen, a star appeared from the Emptiness; it was red-yellow, streaked swiftly, and vanished southwest of the Ox.

sentences.zh: 壬申，星出天市垣，赤青色，慢流至西鹹西北沒。

translations.literal: Day renshen—a star emerged from the Celestial Market Enclosure, red-blue in color, flowing slowly to vanish northwest of the Western Shaman.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen, a star appeared from the Celestial Market Enclosure; it was red-blue, drifted slowly, and vanished northwest of the Western Shaman.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，星出壁宿，赤黃色，急流犯王良星沒，如太白。

translations.literal: Day guiyou—a star emerged from the Wall lodge, red-yellow in color, flowing swiftly to strike and vanish at the star Wang Liang, like the Great White.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou, a star appeared from the Wall; it was red-yellow, streaked swiftly, struck Wang Liang, and vanished, looking like Venus.

sentences.zh: 丙子，星出羽林軍門，青白色，慢流委曲行，至東南濁沒。

translations.literal: Day bingzi—a star emerged from the gate of the Feathered Forest Army, blue-white in color, flowing slowly in a winding course, vanishing in the southeastern Turbid.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, a star appeared from the gate of the Feathered Forest Army; it was blue-white, drifted slowly along a winding path, and vanished in the southeastern Turbid.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，星出南斗，赤黃色，慢流入羽林軍沒，有尾跡，大如金星；

translations.literal: Day xinsi—a star emerged from the Southern Dipper, red-yellow in color, flowing slowly into the Feathered Forest Army and vanishing, with a tail-trail, as large as the Metal Star;
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, a star appeared from the Southern Dipper; it was red-yellow, drifted slowly into the Feathered Forest Army and vanished, had a tail-trail, and was as large as Venus;

sentences.zh: 次有星一，赤黃色，有尾跡，亦如金星，出雲雨星，慢流向西南，至女宿之下沒。

translations.literal: next there was one star, red-yellow in color, with a tail-trail, also like the Metal Star, emerging from the Clouds and Rain star, flowing slowly toward the southwest, vanishing below the Woman lodge.
translations.idiomatic: next another star, red-yellow and also with a tail-trail like Venus, appeared from the Clouds and Rain star, drifted slowly southwest, and vanished below the Woman.

sentences.zh: 戊子，星出羽林軍門東南，慢流至濁沒，青白色，有尾跡，大如土星。

translations.literal: Day wuzi—a star emerged southeast of the gate of the Feathered Forest Army, flowing slowly to vanish at the Turbid, blue-white, with a tail-trail, as large as the Earth Star.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi, a star appeared southeast of the gate of the Feathered Forest Army, drifted slowly, and vanished at the Turbid; it was blue-white, had a tail-trail, and was as large as Saturn.

sentences.zh: 又星一，青白色，出天倉，向東南急流，有尾跡，小如木星，至濁沒。

translations.literal: Again one star, blue-white in color, emerged from the Celestial Granary, flowing swiftly toward the southeast, with a tail-trail, as small as the Wood Star, vanishing at the Turbid.
translations.idiomatic: Another star, blue-white, appeared from the Celestial Granary, streaked swiftly southeast, had a tail-trail, was as small as Jupiter, and vanished at the Turbid.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，星出紫微垣外坐，赤黃色，向西北急流，抵紫微垣內坐尚書星沒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengxu—a star emerged from the outer seat of the Purple Palace Enclosure, red-yellow in color, flowing swiftly northwest, reaching and vanishing at the Minister of Works star of the inner seat of the Purple Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day gengxu, a star appeared from the outer seat of the Purple Palace Enclosure; it was red-yellow, streaked swiftly northwest, and vanished at the Minister of Works star of the inner seat.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，星出軫宿，急流向東南騎官星沒，赤黃色，有尾跡，大如木星。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengyin—a star emerged from the Axletree lodge, flowing swiftly to vanish at the Cavalry Officer star in the southeast, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, as large as the Wood Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day gengyin, a star appeared from the Axletree, streaked swiftly southeast, and vanished at the Cavalry Officer star; it was red-yellow, had a tail-trail, and was as large as Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 丁未，飛星出天船，急流向紫微垣外坐內廚西北沒，炸出二小星，青白色，有尾跡，照地，大如木星。

translations.literal: Day dingwei—a flying star emerged from the Celestial Boat, flowing swiftly to vanish northwest of the inner kitchen of the outer seat of the Purple Palace Enclosure, bursting out two small stars, blue-white, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground, as large as the Wood Star.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei, a flying star appeared from the Celestial Boat, streaked swiftly, and vanished northwest of the inner kitchen of the outer seat of the Purple Palace Enclosure, bursting into two smaller stars; it was blue-white, had a tail-trail, lit the ground, and was as large as Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 二年二月辛酉，飛星出權星，慢流至太微垣內五帝坐大星西南沒，青白色，微有尾跡，大如歲星。

translations.literal: Second year, second month, day xinyou—a flying star emerged from the Balance star, flowing slowly to vanish southwest of the great star of the Five Emperors' Seat within the Supreme Palace Enclosure, blue-white, slightly with a tail-trail, as large as the Year Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year, on the day xinyou, a flying star appeared from the Balance star, drifted slowly, and vanished southwest of the great star of the Five Emperors' Seat inside the Supreme Palace Enclosure; it was blue-white, had a slight tail-trail, and was as large as Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，星出王良，青白色，急流犯天津西南沒。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingchou—a star emerged from Wang Liang, blue-white in color, flowing swiftly to strike and vanish southwest of the Celestial Ford.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day dingchou, a star appeared from Wang Liang; it was blue-white, streaked swiftly, struck the Celestial Ford, and vanished to its southwest.

sentences.zh: 己卯，飛星出造父，急流入紫微垣內鉤陳大星東南沒，青白色，大如填星。

translations.literal: Day jimao—a flying star emerged from Zaofu, flowing swiftly to vanish southeast of the great star of Gouchen within the Purple Palace Enclosure, blue-white, as large as the Filling Star.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao, a flying star appeared from Zaofu, streaked swiftly, and vanished southeast of the great star of Gouchen inside the Purple Palace Enclosure; it was blue-white and as large as Saturn.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，星出天關，急流貫入畢口西北沒，有尾跡，照地明，大如太白，赤黃色。

translations.literal: Day xinhai—a star emerged from the Celestial Pass, flowing swiftly to pierce and enter the mouth of the Net and vanish in the northwest, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly, as large as the Great White, red-yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai, a star appeared from the Celestial Pass, streaked swiftly through the mouth of the Net, and vanished in the northwest; it had a tail-trail, lit the ground brightly, was as large as Venus, and was red-yellow.

sentences.zh: 十月丙辰，星出趙國，向西南慢流，犯趙東星沒，有尾跡，大如填星，赤黃色。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day bingchen—a star emerged from the State of Zhao, flowing slowly toward the southwest, striking and vanishing at the eastern star of Zhao, with a tail-trail, as large as the Filling Star, red-yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day bingchen, a star appeared from the State of Zhao, drifted slowly southwest, struck the eastern star of Zhao, and vanished; it had a tail-trail, was as large as Saturn, and was red-yellow.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午朔，星出卯位，慢流至西南沒，有尾跡，照地明，大如太白，青白色。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, first day of the month renwu—a star emerged from the mao position, flowing slowly to vanish in the southwest, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly, as large as the Great White, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month, the day renwu, a star appeared from the mao position, drifted slowly southwest, and vanished; it had a tail-trail, lit the ground brightly, was as large as Venus, and was blue-white.

sentences.zh: 癸未，星出，犯弧矢，急流至天廟東南沒，有尾跡，大如太白，青白色。

translations.literal: Day guiwei—a star emerged, striking the Bow and Arrow, flowing swiftly to vanish southeast of the Celestial Temple, with a tail-trail, as large as the Great White, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei, a star appeared, struck the Bow and Arrow, streaked swiftly, and vanished southeast of the Celestial Temple; it had a tail-trail, was as large as Venus, and was blue-white.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，星出天苑，向西南慢流，至濁沒，微有尾跡，大如太白，色赤黃。

translations.literal: Day dinghai—a star emerged from the Celestial Park, flowing slowly toward the southwest, vanishing at the Turbid, slightly with a tail-trail, as large as the Great White, red-yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai, a star appeared from the Celestial Park, drifted slowly southwest, and vanished at the Turbid; it had a slight tail-trail, was as large as Venus, and was red-yellow.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，星出羽林軍，慢流向西南濁沒，大如太白，色赤黃。

translations.literal: Day guimao—a star emerged from the Feathered Forest Army, flowing slowly toward the southwestern Turbid and vanishing, as large as the Great White, red-yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, a star appeared from the Feathered Forest Army, drifted slowly toward the southwestern Turbid, and vanished; it was as large as Venus and red-yellow in color.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，星出南河，向東南慢流，至翼宿沒，微有尾跡，大如太白，色赤黃。

translations.literal: Day xinhai—a star emerged from the South River, flowing slowly toward the southeast, vanishing at the Wings lodge, slightly with a tail-trail, as large as the Great White, red-yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai, a star appeared from the South River, drifted slowly southeast, and vanished at the Wings; it had a slight tail-trail, was as large as Venus, and was red-yellow.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，星出弧矢，向東南至濁沒，有尾跡，照地明，大如太白，色青白。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renwu—a star emerged from the Bow and Arrow, flowing toward the southeast to vanish at the Turbid, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly, as large as the Great White, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day renwu, a star appeared from the Bow and Arrow, streaked southeast, and vanished at the Turbid; it had a tail-trail, lit the ground brightly, was as large as Venus, and was blue-white.

sentences.zh: 乾道元年三月丙辰，星出周國，急流至天雞沒，微有尾跡，大如歲星，色黃白。

translations.literal: First year of Qiandao, third month, day bingchen—a star emerged from the State of Zhou, flowing swiftly to vanish at the Celestial Cock, slightly with a tail-trail, as large as the Year Star, yellow-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of the Qiandao era, on the day bingchen, a star appeared from the State of Zhou, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the Celestial Cock; it had a slight tail-trail, was as large as Jupiter, and was yellow-white.

sentences.zh: 甲子，星出張宿，慢流向西南，至濁沒，有尾跡，照地明，大如太白，色赤黃。

translations.literal: Day jiazi—a star emerged from the Spread lodge, flowing slowly toward the southwest, vanishing at the Turbid, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly, as large as the Great White, red-yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi, a star appeared from the Spread, drifted slowly southwest, and vanished at the Turbid; it had a tail-trail, lit the ground brightly, was as large as Venus, and was red-yellow.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，星出河鼓，白色，向東北慢流，至濁沒，有尾跡，照地明，大如太白，六月甲辰，星出東北，慢流向西南沒，有尾跡、音聲，大如太白，色赤黃。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingchou—a star emerged from the Drum at the River, white in color, flowing slowly northeast, vanishing at the Turbid, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly, as large as the Great White; sixth month, day jiachen—a star emerged in the northeast, flowing slowly southwest and vanishing, with a tail-trail and sound, as large as the Great White, red-yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day dingchou, a white star appeared from the Drum at the River, drifted slowly northeast, and vanished at the Turbid; it had a tail-trail, lit the ground brightly, and was as large as Venus. In the sixth month, on the day jiachen, a star appeared in the northeast, drifted slowly southwest, and vanished; it had a tail-trail and made a sound, was as large as Venus, and was red-yellow.

sentences.zh: 七月壬戌，星出西南，慢流至東南沒，大如歲星，色赤黃。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day renxu—a star emerged in the southwest, flowing slowly to vanish in the southeast, as large as the Year Star, red-yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the day renxu, a star appeared in the southwest, drifted slowly southeast, and vanished; it was as large as Jupiter and red-yellow.

sentences.zh: 庚午，星出代國，慢流至趙國沒，大如歲星，色青白。

translations.literal: Day gengwu—a star emerged from the State of Dai, flowing slowly to vanish at the State of Zhao, as large as the Year Star, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu, a star appeared from the State of Dai, drifted slowly, and vanished at the State of Zhao; it was as large as Jupiter and blue-white.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，星出王良，慢流至尾宿沒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wushen—a star emerged from Wang Liang, flowing slowly to vanish at the Tail lodge.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day wushen, a star appeared from Wang Liang, drifted slowly, and vanished at the Tail.

sentences.zh: 十月癸未，星出權星東南，急流至太微垣沒，有尾跡，照地明，如太白，色青白。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day guiwei—a star emerged southeast of the Balance star, flowing swiftly to vanish at the Supreme Palace Enclosure, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly, like the Great White, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day guiwei, a star appeared southeast of the Balance star, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the Supreme Palace Enclosure; it had a tail-trail, lit the ground brightly, was like Venus, and was blue-white.

sentences.zh: 二年二月庚子，星出西北方，急流至濁沒，明大如歲星，色青白。

translations.literal: Second year, second month, day gengzi—a star emerged in the northwest, flowing swiftly to vanish at the Turbid, bright and large like the Year Star, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year, on the day gengzi, a star appeared in the northwest, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the Turbid; it was as bright and large as Jupiter and blue-white.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，星出角宿，急流至軫宿沒，有尾跡，大如太白，色赤黃。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingzi—a star emerged from the Horn lodge, flowing swiftly to vanish at the Axletree lodge, with a tail-trail, as large as the Great White, red-yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day bingzi, a star appeared from the Horn, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the Axletree; it had a tail-trail, was as large as Venus, and was red-yellow.

sentences.zh: 七月己巳，星出織女，急流至天市垣內宗星沒，有尾跡，大如歲星，青白色。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day jisi—a star emerged from the Weaving Maid, flowing swiftly to vanish at the Zong star within the Celestial Market Enclosure, with a tail-trail, as large as the Year Star, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the day jisi, a star appeared from the Weaving Maid, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the Zong star inside the Celestial Market Enclosure; it had a tail-trail, was as large as Jupiter, and was blue-white.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，星出，急流東南蒼黑雲間沒，大如歲星，色青白。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiwei—a star emerged, flowing swiftly to vanish amid dark blue clouds in the southeast, as large as the Year Star, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day jiwei, a star appeared, streaked swiftly, and vanished amid dark blue clouds in the southeast; it was as large as Jupiter and blue-white.

sentences.zh: 十二月，星出天關，急流至外屏星沒，有二小星隨之，赤黃色，微有尾跡，大如歲星。

translations.literal: Twelfth month—a star emerged from the Celestial Pass, flowing swiftly to vanish at the Outer Screen star, two small stars following it, red-yellow, slightly with a tail-trail, as large as the Year Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, a star appeared from the Celestial Pass, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the Outer Screen, followed by two smaller stars; it was red-yellow, had a slight tail-trail, and was as large as Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 三年九月甲午，星出捲舌，急流至婁宿沒，有尾跡，大如歲星，黃白色。

translations.literal: Third year, ninth month, day jiawu—a star emerged from the Rolled Tongue, flowing swiftly to vanish at the Bond lodge, with a tail-trail, as large as the Year Star, yellow-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the third year, on the day jiawu, a star appeared from the Rolled Tongue, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the Bond; it had a tail-trail, was as large as Jupiter, and was yellow-white.

sentences.zh: 又有星青白色，出北斗，急流至少宰西北沒，大如歲星。

translations.literal: Again there was a star, blue-white in color, emerging from the Northern Dipper, flowing swiftly to vanish northwest of the Lesser Minister, as large as the Year Star.
translations.idiomatic: Another star, blue-white, appeared from the Northern Dipper, streaked swiftly, and vanished northwest of the Lesser Minister; it was as large as Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 五年七月甲子，星出宗正，赤色，慢流至女宿沒，有尾跡，照地明，大如歲星。

translations.literal: Fifth year, seventh month, day jiazi—a star emerged from the Director of the Imperial Clan, red in color, flowing slowly to vanish at the Woman lodge, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly, as large as the Year Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year, on the day jiazi, a red star appeared from the Director of the Imperial Clan, drifted slowly, and vanished at the Woman; it had a tail-trail, lit the ground brightly, and was as large as Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，星出，赤黃色，如蛇，入天棓沒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingchen—a star emerged, red-yellow in color, like a snake, entering and vanishing at the Celestial Club.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day bingchen, a star appeared, red-yellow and serpent-like, and vanished in the Celestial Club.

sentences.zh: 六年九月辛巳，星出狼星，入弧矢，至濁沒，微有尾跡，大如填星，赤黃色。

translations.literal: Sixth year, ninth month, day xinsi—a star emerged from the Wolf star, entering the Bow and Arrow, vanishing at the Turbid, slightly with a tail-trail, as large as the Filling Star, red-yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the sixth year, on the day xinsi, a star appeared from the Wolf star, entered the Bow and Arrow, and vanished at the Turbid; it had a slight tail-trail, was as large as Saturn, and was red-yellow.

sentences.zh: 十月庚戌，星出天囷，急流至濁沒，有尾跡，大如歲星，赤黃色。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day gengxu—a star emerged from the Celestial Round Granary, flowing swiftly to vanish at the Turbid, with a tail-trail, as large as the Year Star, red-yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day gengxu, a star appeared from the Celestial Round Granary, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the Turbid; it had a tail-trail, was as large as Jupiter, and was red-yellow.

sentences.zh: 七年七月戊戌，星大如拳，急流向西北方，至濁沒，有尾跡，照地如電。

translations.literal: Seventh year, seventh month, day wuxu—a star as large as a fist, flowing swiftly toward the northwest, vanishing at the Turbid, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground like lightning.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the seventh year, on the day wuxu, a star as large as a fist streaked northwest and vanished at the Turbid; it had a tail-trail and lit the ground like lightning.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，透雲星出，急流向西南方，至濁沒，高丈餘，有尾跡，照地明，大如太白，色青白。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiawu—a cloud-piercing star emerged, flowing swiftly toward the southwest, vanishing at the Turbid, more than one zhang in height, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly, as large as the Great White, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day jiawu, a cloud-piercing star appeared, streaked southwest, and vanished at the Turbid; it was more than ten feet high, had a tail-trail, lit the ground brightly, was as large as Venus, and was blue-white.

sentences.zh: 淳熙三年正月辛未，星出狼星，急流至濁沒，尾跡照地明，大如太白，四月戊戌，星出角宿，青白色。

translations.literal: Third year of Chunxi, first month, day xinwei—a star emerged from the Wolf star, flowing swiftly to vanish at the Turbid, its tail-trail illuminating the ground brightly, as large as the Great White; fourth month, day wuxu—a star emerged from the Horn lodge, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year of the Chunxi era, on the day xinwei, a star appeared from the Wolf star, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the Turbid; its tail-trail lit the ground brightly, and it was as large as Venus. In the fourth month, on the day wuxu, a star appeared from the Horn; it was blue-white.

sentences.zh: 五年八月乙巳，星出狼星，急流向東南沒，微有尾跡，大如太白，青白色。

translations.literal: Fifth year, eighth month, day yisi—a star emerged from the Wolf star, flowing swiftly to vanish in the southeast, slightly with a tail-trail, as large as the Great White, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fifth year, on the day yisi, a star appeared from the Wolf star, streaked swiftly southeast, and vanished; it had a slight tail-trail, was as large as Venus, and was blue-white.

sentences.zh: 六年八月壬辰，星出紫微垣鉤陳大星，慢流至濁沒，有尾跡，大如盞口，青白色。

translations.literal: Sixth year, eighth month, day renchen—a star emerged from the great star of Gouchen in the Purple Palace Enclosure, flowing slowly to vanish at the Turbid, with a tail-trail, as large as a cup rim, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the sixth year, on the day renchen, a star appeared from the great star of Gouchen in the Purple Palace Enclosure, drifted slowly, and vanished at the Turbid; it had a tail-trail, was as large as a cup opening, and was blue-white.

sentences.zh: 七年五月乙亥，星出天市垣內東海星，慢流，炸作三小星，有尾跡，照地，大如盞口，青白色。

translations.literal: Seventh year, fifth month, day yihai—a star emerged from the Eastern Sea star within the Celestial Market Enclosure, flowing slowly, bursting into three small stars, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground, as large as a cup rim, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventh year, on the day yihai, a star appeared from the Eastern Sea star inside the Celestial Market Enclosure, drifted slowly, and burst into three smaller stars; it had a tail-trail, lit the ground, was as large as a cup opening, and was blue-white.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未，星出貫索大星西北，急流至濁沒，有尾跡，照地明，大如太白，色青白。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingwei—a star emerged northwest of the great star of the Coiled Thong, flowing swiftly to vanish at the Turbid, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly, as large as the Great White, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day dingwei, a star appeared northwest of the great star of the Coiled Thong, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the Turbid; it had a tail-trail, lit the ground brightly, was as large as Venus, and was blue-white.

sentences.zh: 十一年四月乙丑，星出自中天，慢流向東北方沒，微有尾跡，炸作小星相從，有聲，明大如太白，色青白。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, fourth month, day yichou—a star emerged from the center of the sky, flowing slowly to vanish in the northeast, slightly with a tail-trail, bursting into small stars following one another, with sound, bright and large like the Great White, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the eleventh year, on the day yichou, a star appeared from the center of the sky, drifted slowly northeast, and vanished; it had a slight tail-trail, burst into accompanying smaller stars with a sound, was as bright and large as Venus, and was blue-white.

sentences.zh: 十五年二月辛未，星出太尊，大如盞口，急流至濁沒，色青白。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, second month, day xinwei—a star emerged from Supreme Honor, as large as a cup rim, flowing swiftly to vanish at the Turbid, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fifteenth year, on the day xinwei, a star appeared from Supreme Honor, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the Turbid; it was as large as a cup opening and blue-white.

sentences.zh: 慶元二年九月甲午、四年六月甲午，星皆晝隕。

translations.literal: Second year of Qingyuan, ninth month, day jiawu, and fourth year, sixth month, day jiawu—stars all fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu in the ninth month of the second year of the Qingyuan era, and again on the day jiawu in the sixth month of the fourth year, stars fell during the day.

sentences.zh: 七月壬寅，星出羽林軍下，青白色，大如碗。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day renyin—a star emerged below the Feathered Forest Army, blue-white in color, as large as a bowl.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the day renyin, a star appeared below the Feathered Forest Army; it was blue-white and as large as a bowl.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，星出奎宿，向壁壘陣沒，赤白色，大如太白，五年六月丁丑，星出東北，慢流至西南方沒，大如歲星，青白色。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingsi—a star emerged from the Strider lodge, flowing toward and vanishing at the Wall and Rampart Formation, red-white in color, as large as the Great White; fifth year, sixth month, day dingchou—a star emerged in the northeast, flowing slowly to vanish in the southwest, as large as the Year Star, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day dingsi, a star appeared from the Strider and vanished at the Wall and Rampart Formation; it was red-white and as large as Venus. In the sixth month of the fifth year, on the day dingchou, a star appeared in the northeast, drifted slowly southwest, and vanished; it was as large as Jupiter and blue-white.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，星出西南，慢流向東北沒，大如太白，青白色，

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renzi—a star emerged in the southwest, flowing slowly northeast and vanishing, as large as the Great White, blue-white in color,
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day renzi, a star appeared in the southwest, drifted slowly northeast, and vanished; it was as large as Venus and blue-white,

sentences.zh: 嘉泰二年四月辛巳，星出西北，急流東北至濁沒，色赤。

translations.literal: Second year of Jiatai, fourth month, day xinsi—a star emerged in the northwest, flowing swiftly northeast to vanish at the Turbid, red in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of the Jiatai era, on the day xinsi, a star appeared in the northwest, streaked northeast, and vanished at the Turbid; it was red.

sentences.zh: 十月乙酉，星出五車，大如歲星。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day yiyou—a star emerged from the Five Chariots, as large as the Year Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day yiyou, a star appeared from the Five Chariots; it was as large as Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 四年十一月庚午，星出天津，急流入天市垣沒。

translations.literal: Fourth year, eleventh month, day gengwu—a star emerged from the Celestial Ford, flowing swiftly to enter and vanish at the Celestial Market Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fourth year, on the day gengwu, a star appeared from the Celestial Ford, streaked swiftly, and vanished in the Celestial Market Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 開禧元年正月庚子，星出中天，赤色，大如太白。

translations.literal: First year of Kaixi, first month, day gengzi—a star emerged from the center of the sky, red in color, as large as the Great White.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of the Kaixi era, on the day gengzi, a star appeared from the center of the sky; it was red and as large as Venus.

sentences.zh: 向濁沒。

translations.literal: Flowing toward the Turbid and vanishing.
translations.idiomatic: It streaked toward the Turbid and vanished.

sentences.zh: 七月癸亥，星出天津，入鬥宿東南沒，色赤，大如太白，二年六月癸丑，星出招搖，入庫樓，色赤，大如太白。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day guihai—a star emerged from the Celestial Ford, entering and vanishing southeast of the Dipper lodge, red in color, as large as the Great White; second year, sixth month, day guichou—a star emerged from the Swaying Token, entering the Arsenal Tower, red in color, as large as the Great White.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the day guihai, a star appeared from the Celestial Ford and vanished southeast of the Dipper; it was red and as large as Venus. In the sixth month of the second year, on the day guichou, a star appeared from the Swaying Token and entered the Arsenal Tower; it was red and as large as Venus.

sentences.zh: 嘉定元年六月辛未，星出天津東北，慢流向天市垣沒。

translations.literal: First year of Jiading, sixth month, day xinwei—a star emerged northeast of the Celestial Ford, flowing slowly toward and vanishing at the Celestial Market Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of the Jiading era, on the day xinwei, a star appeared northeast of the Celestial Ford, drifted slowly, and vanished at the Celestial Market Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 二年六月壬午，星出織女東南，慢流入天市垣沒，色赤，有尾跡，照地明，大如太白。

translations.literal: Second year, sixth month, day renwu—a star emerged southeast of the Weaving Maid, flowing slowly to enter and vanish at the Celestial Market Enclosure, red in color, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly, as large as the Great White.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year, on the day renwu, a star appeared southeast of the Weaving Maid, drifted slowly, and vanished in the Celestial Market Enclosure; it was red, had a tail-trail, lit the ground brightly, and was as large as Venus.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，星出中天，急流向東北，至濁沒。

translations.literal: Day gengyin—a star emerged from the center of the sky, flowing swiftly northeast, vanishing at the Turbid.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin, a star appeared from the center of the sky, streaked northeast, and vanished at the Turbid.

sentences.zh: 三年九月己酉，星夕隕。

translations.literal: Third year, ninth month, day jiyou—a star fell at evening.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the third year, on the day jiyou, a star fell at evening.

sentences.zh: 五年七月乙巳，星出中天，慢流向西南方，至濁沒。

translations.literal: Fifth year, seventh month, day yisi—a star emerged from the center of the sky, flowing slowly toward the southwest, vanishing at the Turbid.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year, on the day yisi, a star appeared from the center of the sky, drifted slowly southwest, and vanished at the Turbid.

sentences.zh: 六年五月癸亥，星晝隕。

translations.literal: Sixth year, fifth month, day guihai—a star fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the sixth year, on the day guihai, a star fell during the day.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，星夕隕。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guimao—a star fell at evening.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day guimao, a star fell at evening.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，星晝隕。

translations.literal: Day dingsi—a star fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi, a star fell during the day.

sentences.zh: 十月戊戌，星出昴宿西南，慢流向天廩東南沒。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day wuxu—a star emerged southwest of the Hairy Head lodge, flowing slowly toward and vanishing southeast of the Celestial Storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day wuxu, a star appeared southwest of the Hairy Head, drifted slowly, and vanished southeast of the Celestial Storehouse.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，星出西南，慢流至濁沒，青白色。

translations.literal: Day renxu—a star emerged in the southwest, flowing slowly to vanish at the Turbid, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, a star appeared in the southwest, drifted slowly, and vanished at the Turbid; it was blue-white.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，星晝隕。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renyin—a star fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day renyin, a star fell during the day.

sentences.zh: 七年三月壬午，星出軫宿距星東南，慢流至濁沒。

translations.literal: Seventh year, third month, day renwu—a star emerged southeast of the spaced star of the Axletree lodge, flowing slowly to vanish at the Turbid.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventh year, on the day renwu, a star appeared southeast of the spaced star of the Axletree, drifted slowly, and vanished at the Turbid.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯，星出天津西南，慢流向心宿西北沒。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinmao—a star emerged southwest of the Celestial Ford, flowing slowly toward and vanishing northwest of the Heart lodge.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day xinmao, a star appeared southwest of the Celestial Ford, drifted slowly, and vanished northwest of the Heart.

sentences.zh: 八年七月癸未，星出室宿距星東北，急流向天倉星西北沒。

translations.literal: Eighth year, seventh month, day guiwei—a star emerged northeast of the spaced star of the Encampment lodge, flowing swiftly toward and vanishing northwest of the Celestial Granary star.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the eighth year, on the day guiwei, a star appeared northeast of the spaced star of the Encampment, streaked swiftly, and vanished northwest of the Celestial Granary star.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，星出織女東南，慢流向牛宿西北沒，有尾跡，照地明，大如太白，青白色。

translations.literal: Day yiyou—a star emerged southeast of the Weaving Maid, flowing slowly toward and vanishing northwest of the Ox lodge, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly, as large as the Great White, blue-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou, a star appeared southeast of the Weaving Maid, drifted slowly, and vanished northwest of the Ox; it had a tail-trail, lit the ground brightly, was as large as Venus, and was blue-white.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰，星出天津西南，慢流向河鼓東北沒。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiachen—a star emerged southwest of the Celestial Ford, flowing slowly toward and vanishing northeast of the Drum at the River.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day jiachen, a star appeared southwest of the Celestial Ford, drifted slowly, and vanished northeast of the Drum at the River.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，星出五諸侯東北，慢流向天關西南沒，有聲及尾跡，明照地，赤黃色。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingshen—a star emerged northeast of the Five Feudal Lords, flowing slowly toward and vanishing southwest of the Celestial Pass, with sound and a tail-trail, brightly illuminating the ground, red-yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day bingshen, a star appeared northeast of the Five Feudal Lords, drifted slowly, and vanished southwest of the Celestial Pass; it made a sound, had a tail-trail, brightly lit the ground, and was red-yellow.

sentences.zh: 九年六月乙巳，星出牛宿距星東北，慢流至濁沒。

translations.literal: Ninth year, sixth month, day yisi—a star emerged northeast of the spaced star of the Ox lodge, flowing slowly to vanish at the Turbid.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the ninth year, on the day yisi, a star appeared northeast of the spaced star of the Ox, drifted slowly, and vanished at the Turbid.

sentences.zh: 十年五月壬申，星出尾宿距星西北，慢流向牛宿距星東南沒。

translations.literal: Tenth year, fifth month, day renshen—a star emerged northwest of the spaced star of the Tail lodge, flowing slowly toward and vanishing southeast of the spaced star of the Ox lodge.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the tenth year, on the day renshen, a star appeared northwest of the spaced star of the Tail, drifted slowly, and vanished southeast of the spaced star of the Ox.

sentences.zh: 十一年六月乙卯，星出河鼓距星西南，急流向正西，至濁沒。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, sixth month, day yimao—a star emerged southwest of the spaced star of the Drum at the River, flowing swiftly due west, vanishing at the Turbid.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eleventh year, on the day yimao, a star appeared southwest of the spaced star of the Drum at the River, streaked due west, and vanished at the Turbid.

sentences.zh: 十二年十一月乙亥，星出昴宿東南，急流至濁沒。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, eleventh month, day yihai—a star emerged southeast of the Hairy Head lodge, flowing swiftly to vanish at the Turbid.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the twelfth year, on the day yihai, a star appeared southeast of the Hairy Head, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the Turbid.

sentences.zh: 十三年十二月丁巳，星出軫旗東北，慢流至濁沒，赤黃色。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, twelfth month, day dingsi—a star emerged northeast of the Axletree Banner, flowing slowly to vanish at the Turbid, red-yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the thirteenth year, on the day dingsi, a star appeared northeast of the Axletree Banner, drifted slowly, and vanished at the Turbid; it was red-yellow.

sentences.zh: 十四年二月壬午，星出南河距星東南，慢流向西南，至濁沒，赤黃色。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, second month, day renwu—a star emerged southeast of the spaced star of the South River, flowing slowly toward the southwest, vanishing at the Turbid, red-yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourteenth year, on the day renwu, a star appeared southeast of the spaced star of the South River, drifted slowly southwest, and vanished at the Turbid; it was red-yellow.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，星出房宿距星，急流至濁沒，有尾跡，照地明，大如太白，赤黃色。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuwu—a star emerged from the spaced star of the Room lodge, flowing swiftly to vanish at the Turbid, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly, as large as the Great White, red-yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day wuwu, a star appeared from the spaced star of the Room, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the Turbid; it had a tail-trail, lit the ground brightly, was as large as Venus, and was red-yellow.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，星出天倉距星四北，慢流向東南方，至濁沒，赤黃色。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiashen—a star emerged north of the spaced star of the Celestial Granary, flowing slowly toward the southeast, vanishing at the Turbid, red-yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day jiashen, a star appeared north of the spaced star of the Celestial Granary, drifted slowly southeast, and vanished at the Turbid; it was red-yellow.

sentences.zh: 十六年十一月壬戌，星出五諸侯東北，急流向西北，至濁沒，色赤黃，隆隆有聲，及尾跡照地，大如盞。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year, eleventh month, day renxu—a star emerged northeast of the Five Feudal Lords, flowing swiftly toward the northwest, vanishing at the Turbid, red-yellow in color, rumbling with sound, and its tail-trail illuminating the ground, as large as a cup.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the sixteenth year, on the day renxu, a star appeared northeast of the Five Feudal Lords, streaked northwest, and vanished at the Turbid; it was red-yellow, made a rumbling sound, its tail-trail lit the ground, and it was as large as a cup.

sentences.zh: 寶慶二年四月辛亥，星出，大如太白，

translations.literal: Second year of Baoqing, fourth month, day xinhai—a star emerged, as large as the Great White,
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of the Baoqing era, on the day xinhai, a star appeared; it was as large as Venus,

sentences.zh: 紹定元年六月己酉，星晝隕。

translations.literal: First year of Shaoding, sixth month, day jiyou—a star fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of the Shaoding era, on the day jiyou, a star fell during the day.

sentences.zh: 二年正月庚辰、九月壬辰，星出，大如太白，三年十一月丁未，星晝隕。

translations.literal: Second year, first month, day gengchen, and ninth month, day renchen—stars emerged, as large as the Great White; third year, eleventh month, day dingwei—a star fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen in the first month and the day renchen in the ninth month of the second year, stars appeared; they were as large as Venus. In the eleventh month of the third year, on the day dingwei, a star fell during the day.

sentences.zh: 四年七月庚戌，星出，大如太白，九月甲辰，星晝隕。

translations.literal: Fourth year, seventh month, day gengxu—a star emerged, as large as the Great White; ninth month, day jiachen—a star fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year, on the day gengxu, a star appeared; it was as large as Venus. In the ninth month, on the day jiachen, a star fell during the day.

sentences.zh: 五年八月甲寅，星夕隕。

translations.literal: Fifth year, eighth month, day jiayin—a star fell at evening.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fifth year, on the day jiayin, a star fell at evening.

sentences.zh: 閏九月己酉，星出，大如太白，

translations.literal: Intercalary ninth month, day jiyou—a star emerged, as large as the Great White,
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary ninth month, on the day jiyou, a star appeared; it was as large as Venus,

sentences.zh: 端平元年六月丙戌，星西南行，大如太白，有尾跡，照地明。

translations.literal: First year of Duanping, sixth month, day bingxu—a star traveled southwest, as large as the Great White, with a tail-trail, illuminating the ground brightly.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of the Duanping era, on the day bingxu, a star traveled southwest; it was as large as Venus, had a tail-trail, and lit the ground brightly.

sentences.zh: 二年四月戊子，星出，大如太白，六月庚辰，星晝隕。

translations.literal: Second year, fourth month, day wuzi—a star emerged, as large as the Great White; sixth month, day gengchen—a star fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year, on the day wuzi, a star appeared; it was as large as Venus. In the sixth month, on the day gengchen, a star fell during the day.

sentences.zh: 七月丁酉，星出，大如太白，辛丑，星晝隕。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day dingyou—a star emerged, as large as the Great White; day xinchou—a star fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the day dingyou, a star appeared; it was as large as Venus. On the day xinchou, a star fell during the day.

sentences.zh: 十月辛卯，星出，大如太白，三年五月庚辰，星出心宿，大如太白，六月癸巳，星夕隕。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day xinmao—a star emerged, as large as the Great White; third year, fifth month, day gengchen—a star emerged from the Heart lodge, as large as the Great White; sixth month, day guisi—a star fell at evening.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day xinmao, a star appeared; it was as large as Venus. In the fifth month of the third year, on the day gengchen, a star appeared from the Heart; it was as large as Venus. In the sixth month, on the day guisi, a star fell at evening.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙元年正月壬午，星出，大如太白，二月己丑，星夕隕。

translations.literal: First year of Jiaxi, first month, day renwu—a star emerged, as large as the Great White; second month, day jichou—a star fell at evening.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of the Jiaxi era, on the day renwu, a star appeared; it was as large as Venus. In the second month, on the day jichou, a star fell at evening.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，星出七公西，至濁沒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guichou—a star emerged west of the Seven Dukes, vanishing at the Turbid.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day guichou, a star appeared west of the Seven Dukes and vanished at the Turbid.

sentences.zh: 十月戊戌，星出，大如桃。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day wuxu—a star emerged, as large as a peach.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day wuxu, a star appeared; it was as large as a peach.

sentences.zh: 二年四月甲子，七月辛卯，九月乙未，星出，大如太白，六月甲辰、八月癸亥，星晝隕。

translations.literal: Second year, fourth month, day jiazi, seventh month, day xinmao, ninth month, day yiwei—stars emerged, as large as the Great White; sixth month, day jiachen, and eighth month, day guihai—stars fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the days jiazi in the fourth month, xinmao in the seventh month, and yiwei in the ninth month of the second year, stars appeared; they were as large as Venus. On the days jiachen in the sixth month and guihai in the eighth month, stars fell during the day.

sentences.zh: 三年三月甲戌，星晝隕。

translations.literal: Third year, third month, day jiaxu—a star fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year, on the day jiaxu, a star fell during the day.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，星出，大如太白，四年正月辛巳，六月戊午，星出，大如太白，二月辛丑、三月癸未，星晝隕。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinchou—a star emerged, as large as the Great White; fourth year, first month, day xinsi, and sixth month, day wuwu—stars emerged, as large as the Great White; second month, day xinchou, and third month, day guiwei—stars fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day xinchou, a star appeared; it was as large as Venus. In the first month of the fourth year, on the day xinsi, and in the sixth month, on the day wuwu, stars appeared; they were as large as Venus. On the days xinchou in the second month and guiwei in the third month, stars fell during the day.

sentences.zh: 淳祐元年六月癸酉，星出，大如太白，己卯，星晝隕。

translations.literal: First year of Chunyou, sixth month, day guiyou—a star emerged, as large as the Great White; day jimao—a star fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of the Chunyou era, on the day guiyou, a star appeared; it was as large as Venus. On the day jimao, a star fell during the day.

sentences.zh: 三年六月甲戌，星出氐宿距星，大如太白，八月乙卯，星晝隕。

translations.literal: Third year, sixth month, day jiaxu—a star emerged from the spaced star of the Root lodge, as large as the Great White; eighth month, day yimao—a star fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year, on the day jiaxu, a star appeared from the spaced star of the Root; it was as large as Venus. In the eighth month, on the day yimao, a star fell during the day.

sentences.zh: 四年四月丙子，星出尾宿距星下，大如太白，六月乙未，星出畢宿，大如太白，六年七月癸酉，星出室宿，大如太白，九月甲子，星出鬥宿，尾跡青白照地，大如太白，七年九月丙辰，星出室宿。

translations.literal: Fourth year, fourth month, day bingzi—a star emerged below the spaced star of the Tail lodge, as large as the Great White; sixth month, day yiwei—a star emerged from the Net lodge, as large as the Great White; sixth year, seventh month, day guiyou—a star emerged from the Encampment lodge, as large as the Great White; ninth month, day jiazi—a star emerged from the Dipper lodge, its tail-trail blue-white illuminating the ground, as large as the Great White; seventh year, ninth month, day bingchen—a star emerged from the Encampment lodge.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year, on the day bingzi, a star appeared below the spaced star of the Tail; it was as large as Venus. In the sixth month, on the day yiwei, a star appeared from the Net; it was as large as Venus. In the seventh month of the sixth year, on the day guiyou, a star appeared from the Encampment; it was as large as Venus. In the ninth month, on the day jiazi, a star appeared from the Dipper; its blue-white tail-trail lit the ground, and it was as large as Venus. In the ninth month of the seventh year, on the day bingchen, a star appeared from the Encampment.

sentences.zh: 八年六月甲辰，星出河鼓，大如太白，十月丙辰，星出角宿距星。

translations.literal: Eighth year, sixth month, day jiachen—a star emerged from the Drum at the River, as large as the Great White; tenth month, day bingchen—a star emerged from the spaced star of the Horn lodge.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighth year, on the day jiachen, a star appeared from the Drum at the River; it was as large as Venus. In the tenth month, on the day bingchen, a star appeared from the spaced star of the Horn.

sentences.zh: 九年六月壬戌，其日，星自南方急流，至濁沒，赤黃色，大如太白，十月壬申，星出織女。

translations.literal: Ninth year, sixth month, day renxu—that day, a star from the south flowing swiftly, vanishing at the Turbid, red-yellow in color, as large as the Great White; tenth month, day renshen—a star emerged from the Weaving Maid.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the ninth year, on the day renxu, that same day a star streaked swiftly from the south and vanished at the Turbid; it was red-yellow and as large as Venus. In the tenth month, on the day renshen, a star appeared from the Weaving Maid.

sentences.zh: 十年四月丁酉朔，星夕隕。

translations.literal: Tenth year, fourth month, first day of the month dingyou—a star fell at evening.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fourth month of the tenth year, the day dingyou, a star fell at evening.

sentences.zh: 十一年七月丁丑，星出畢宿距星，赤黃色，大如太白，八月己丑朔，星夕隕。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, seventh month, day dingchou—a star emerged from the spaced star of the Net lodge, red-yellow in color, as large as the Great White; eighth month, first day of the month jichou—a star fell at evening.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the eleventh year, on the day dingchou, a star appeared from the spaced star of the Net; it was red-yellow and as large as Venus. On the first day of the eighth month, the day jichou, a star fell at evening.

sentences.zh: 十二年四月庚申，星出角宿、亢星，大如太白，八月癸丑，星出角，色赤照地。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, fourth month, day gengshen—a star emerged from the Horn lodge and the Neck star, as large as the Great White; eighth month, day guichou—a star emerged from the Horn, red in color illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twelfth year, on the day gengshen, a star appeared from the Horn and the Neck; it was as large as Venus. In the eighth month, on the day guichou, a star appeared from the Horn; it was red and lit the ground.

sentences.zh: 寶祐元年四月丁巳，星出，大如太白，二年七月庚戌，星出，大如太白，三年七月辛酉，星出，大如太白，十月丁丑，星出畢宿距星。

translations.literal: First year of Baoyou, fourth month, day dingsi—a star emerged, as large as the Great White; second year, seventh month, day gengxu—a star emerged, as large as the Great White; third year, seventh month, day xinyou—a star emerged, as large as the Great White; tenth month, day dingchou—a star emerged from the spaced star of the Net lodge.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of the Baoyou era, on the day dingsi, a star appeared; it was as large as Venus. In the seventh month of the second year, on the day gengxu, a star appeared; it was as large as Venus. In the seventh month of the third year, on the day xinyou, a star appeared; it was as large as Venus. In the tenth month, on the day dingchou, a star appeared from the spaced star of the Net.

sentences.zh: 五年七月丁卯，星出，大如桃。

translations.literal: Fifth year, seventh month, day dingmao—a star emerged, as large as a peach.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year, on the day dingmao, a star appeared; it was as large as a peach.

sentences.zh: 六年九月戊辰，透霞星出。

translations.literal: Sixth year, ninth month, day wuchen—a cloud-piercing star emerged.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the sixth year, on the day wuchen, a cloud-piercing star appeared.

sentences.zh: 開慶元年六月己亥，星出鬥宿河鼓，急流向東南，至濁沒，赤黃色，有音聲，尾跡照地明，大如太白，

translations.literal: First year of Kaiqing, sixth month, day jihai—a star emerged from the Dipper lodge and Drum at the River, flowing swiftly toward the southeast, vanishing at the Turbid, red-yellow in color, with sound, its tail-trail illuminating the ground brightly, as large as the Great White,
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of the Kaiqing era, on the day jihai, a star appeared from the Dipper and Drum at the River, streaked southeast, and vanished at the Turbid; it was red-yellow, made a sound, its tail-trail lit the ground brightly, and it was as large as Venus,

sentences.zh: 景定元年七月丙子，星出東南，大如太白，十月乙卯，星出東北，急流向太陰，有音聲，尾跡照地明，大如桃。

translations.literal: First year of Jingding, seventh month, day bingzi—a star emerged in the southeast, as large as the Great White; tenth month, day yimao—a star emerged in the northeast, flowing swiftly toward the Grand Yin, with sound, its tail-trail illuminating the ground brightly, as large as a peach.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of the Jingding era, on the day bingzi, a star appeared in the southeast; it was as large as Venus. In the tenth month, on the day yimao, a star appeared in the northeast, streaked toward the moon, made a sound, its tail-trail lit the ground brightly, and it was as large as a peach.
