translations.literal: Third year, fourth month, day jiachen—a star emerged, as large as a cup.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year, on the day jiachen, a star appeared; it was as large as a cup.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，星出，大如熒惑。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiyou—a star emerged, as large as the Sparkling Deluder.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day jiyou, a star appeared; it was as large as Mars.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，星出，大如太白，閏九月丙戌，透霞星出，大如太白，庚子，星出，大如太白，四年五月戊戌，星出角宿距星。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingzi—a star emerged, as large as the Great White; intercalary ninth month, day bingxu—a cloud-piercing star emerged, as large as the Great White; day gengzi—a star emerged, as large as the Great White; fourth year, fifth month, day wuxu—a star emerged from the spaced star of the Horn lodge.

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingmao—a star emerged from the Drum at the River.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day dingmao, a star appeared from the Drum at the River.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，星出天倉。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yimao—a star emerged from the Celestial Granary.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day yimao, a star appeared from the Celestial Granary.

sentences.zh: 五年二月壬戌，星出畢宿。

translations.literal: Fifth year, second month, day renxu—a star emerged from the Net lodge.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fifth year, on the day renxu, a star appeared from the Net.

translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day jiawu, a star appeared southeast of the great star of the Drum at the River, streaked northwest, and vanished at the Turbid; it was red-yellow, had a tail-trail, lit the ground brightly, and was as large as Venus. sentences.zh: 鹹淳二年六月甲戌，星出左攝提。

translations.literal: Second year of Xianchun, sixth month, day jiaxu—a star emerged from the Left Sceptre.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of the Xianchun era, on the day jiaxu, a star appeared from the Left Sceptre.

sentences.zh: 三年七月庚寅，星出昴宿東南，急流至濁沒，赤黃，有尾跡，照地明，大如太白，四年七月戊午，星出氐宿距星西北，急流入騎官星沒，赤黃，有尾跡，照地明，大如桃。

translations.literal: Third year, seventh month, day gengyin—a star emerged southeast of the Hairy Head lodge, flowing swiftly to vanish at the Turbid, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground, as large as the Great White; fourth year, seventh month, day wuwu—a star emerged northwest of the spaced star of the Root lodge, flowing swiftly to enter and vanish at the Cavalry Officer star, red-yellow, with a tail-trail, its brightness illuminating the ground, as large as a peach.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year, on the day gengyin, a star appeared southeast of the Hairy Head, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the Turbid; it was red-yellow, had a tail-trail, lit the ground brightly, and was as large as Venus. In the seventh month of the fourth year, on the day wuwu, a star appeared northwest of the spaced star of the Root, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the Cavalry Officer star; it was red-yellow, had a tail-trail, lit the ground brightly, and was as large as a peach.

sentences.zh: 五年五月庚申，星出鬥宿距星東北，急流向牛，至濁沒。

translations.literal: Fifth year, fifth month, day gengshen—a star emerged northeast of the spaced star of the Dipper lodge, flowing swiftly toward the Ox, vanishing at the Turbid.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifth year, on the day gengshen, a star appeared northeast of the spaced star of the Dipper, streaked toward the Ox, and vanished at the Turbid.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅，星出鬥宿。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengyin—a star emerged from the Dipper lodge.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day gengyin, a star appeared from the Dipper.

sentences.zh: 七月壬戌，星出東南河鼓距星西北，急流至濁沒。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day renxu—a star emerged northwest of the spaced star of the River Drum in the southeast, flowing swiftly to vanish at the Turbid.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the day renxu, a star appeared northwest of the spaced star of the Drum at the River in the southeast, streaked swiftly, and vanished at the Turbid.

sentences.zh: 德祐元年四月癸亥，有大星自心東北流入濁沒。

translations.literal: First year of Deyou, fourth month, day guihai—there was a great star flowing from the Heart northeast into the Turbid and vanishing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of the Deyou era, on the day guihai, a great star flowed from the Heart northeastward into the Turbid and vanished.

sentences.zh: 建隆二年五月己丑，天狗墮西南。

translations.literal: Second year of Jianlong, fifth month, day jichou—the Heavenly Dog fell in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of the Jianlong era, on the day jichou, a Heavenly Dog fell in the southwest.

sentences.zh: 紹興十七年正月乙亥，妖星出東北方女宿內，小如歲星，光芒長五丈，二月丙寅始消。

translations.literal: Seventeenth year of Shaoxing, first month, day yihai—a baleful star emerged within the Woman lodge in the northeast, small like the Year Star, its radiance five zhang long; second month, day bingyin—it began to fade.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventeenth year of the Shaoxing era, on the day yihai, a baleful star appeared within the Woman in the northeast; it was as small as Jupiter and its light stretched five zhang. In the second month, on the day bingyin, it began to fade.

sentences.zh: 淳熙十三年九月辛亥，星出，大如太白，色先赤後黃白，尾跡約二尺，委曲如蛇行，類枉矢。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year of Chunxi, ninth month, day xinhai—a star emerged, as large as the Great White, its color first red then yellow-white, its tail-trail about two chi, winding like a snake's crawl, resembling a Crooked Arrow.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the thirteenth year of the Chunxi era, on the day xinhai, a star appeared; it was as large as Venus, first red then yellow-white, its tail-trail about two feet long, winding like a serpent and resembling a Crooked Arrow.

sentences.zh: 十四年五月，有星出濁際，大如日，與日相摩蕩而入。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, fifth month—there was a star emerging at the border of the Turbid, as large as the sun, rubbing and swaying against the sun before entering.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourteenth year, a star appeared at the edge of the Turbid; it was as large as the sun and rubbed and swayed against the sun before entering it.

sentences.zh: 嘉定十一年五月癸未，蚩尤旗竟天。

translations.literal: Eleventh year of Jiading, fifth month, day guiwei—the Chiyou Banner filled the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eleventh year of the Jiading era, on the day guiwei, the Chiyou Banner spanned the entire sky.

sentences.zh: 端平二年春，天狗墜懷安金堂縣，聲如雷，三州之人皆聞之，化爲碎石，其色紅。

translations.literal: Second year of Duanping, spring—a Heavenly Dog fell in Huai'an County of Jintang, its sound like thunder, people of three prefectures all heard it, turning into shattered stone, its color red.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year of the Duanping era, a Heavenly Dog fell in Huai'an County of Jintang; its sound was like thunder and was heard by people across three prefectures, and it turned into red shattered stone.

sentences.zh: 鹹淳十年九月壬寅，有星見西方，曲如蚓。

translations.literal: Tenth year of Xianchun, ninth month, day renyin—there was a star seen in the west, curved like an earthworm.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the tenth year of the Xianchun era, on the day renyin, a star was seen in the west, curved like an earthworm.

sentences.zh: 德祐元年二月丁亥，有星二斗于中天，頃之，一星墜。

translations.literal: First year of Deyou, second month, day dinghai—there were two stars contending at mid-heaven; shortly after, one star fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of the Deyou era, on the day dinghai, two stars contended at mid-heaven; shortly afterward, one of them fell.

sentences.zh: 紹興三十一年六月戊午，大角星東北生角。

translations.literal: Thirty-first year of Shaoxing, sixth month, day wuwu—the Great Horn star sprouted a horn in the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the thirty-first year of the Shaoxing era, on the day wuwu, the Great Horn sprouted a horn toward the northeast.

sentences.zh: 隆興二年九月戊戌，大角光體搖動。

translations.literal: Second year of Longxing, ninth month, day wuxu—the light-body of the Great Horn swayed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year of the Longxing era, on the day wuxu, the light of the Great Horn swayed.

sentences.zh: 十月丙子，弧矢九星內矢一星偏西不向狼星。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day bingzi—within the nine stars of Bow and Arrow, the arrow star was displaced west and did not point toward the Wolf Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day bingzi, among the nine stars of Bow and Arrow, the arrow star was displaced westward and no longer pointed toward the Wolf Star.

sentences.zh: 乾道元年八月乙巳，大角光體搖動。

translations.literal: First year of Qiandao, eighth month, day yisi—the light-body of the Great Horn swayed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of the Qiandao era, on the day yisi, the light of the Great Horn swayed.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年七月辛亥，奎宿生芒。

translations.literal: First year of Chunxi, seventh month, day xinhai—the Strider lodge sprouted rays.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of the Chunxi era, on the day xinhai, the Strider sprouted rays of light.

sentences.zh: 乾德三年七月己卯夜，西方起蒼白氣，長五十丈，貫天船、五車，亙井宿。

translations.literal: Third year of Qiande, seventh month, day jimao, at night—in the west there arose bluish-white vapor, fifty zhang long, piercing the Celestial Boat and Five Chariots, spanning the Well lodge.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day jimao of the seventh month of the third year of the Qiande era, bluish-white vapor arose in the west; it was fifty zhang long, pierced the Celestial Boat and Five Chariots, and stretched across the Well.

sentences.zh: 開寶元年十月乙未旦，西北起蒼白氣三道，長二十丈，趨東散。

translations.literal: First year of Kaibao, tenth month, day yiwei at dawn—from the northwest arose three bands of bluish-white vapor, twenty zhang long, tending east and dispersing.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn on the day yiwei of the tenth month of the first year of the Kaibao era, three bands of bluish-white vapor arose in the northwest; each was twenty zhang long, and they moved eastward and dispersed.

sentences.zh: 太平興國四年四月己巳夜，西北有白氣壓北斗。

translations.literal: Fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, fourth month, day jisi, at night—in the northwest there was white vapor pressing upon the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day jisi of the fourth month of the fourth year of the Taiping Xingguo era, white vapor in the northwest pressed down upon the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 雍熙三年正月己未夜，赤氣如城。

translations.literal: Third year of Yongxi, first month, day jiwei, at night—red vapor like a rampart wall.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day jiwei of the first month of the third year of the Yongxi era, red vapor appeared like a rampart wall.

sentences.zh: 四年正月癸酉夜，白氣起角、亢，經太微垣，曆軒轅大星，至月傍散。

translations.literal: Fourth year, first month, day guiyou, at night—white vapor arose from the Horn and Neck, passing through the Supreme Palace Enclosure, traversing the great star of the Chariot, and dispersing beside the moon.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day guiyou of the first month of the fourth year, white vapor arose from the Horn and Neck, passed through the Supreme Palace Enclosure, traversed the great star of the Chariot, and dispersed beside the moon.

sentences.zh: 端拱元年十月壬申遲明，巽上有雲過中天，連地，濃潤，前赤黃，後黑蒼色，先廣後大，行勢如截。

translations.literal: First year of Duangong, tenth month, day renshen near dawn—in the Xun direction there was a cloud passing mid-heaven, connecting to the ground, thick and moist, front red-yellow, rear black-bluish in color, first broad then large, its movement like cutting off.
translations.idiomatic: Near dawn on the day renshen of the tenth month of the first year of the Duangong era, a cloud passed mid-heaven from the southeast; it reached the ground, was thick and moist, red-yellow in front and black-bluish behind, growing broader and larger as it moved like a shear cut across the sky.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午夜，西北方有赤氣如日腳，高二丈。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuwu, at night—in the northwest there was red vapor like sun-legs, two zhang high.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day wuwu of the eleventh month, red vapor like solar rays appeared in the northwest; it was two zhang high.

sentences.zh: 至道二年二月丙子夜，西方蒼白色氣長短八道，如彗掃，稍經天漢，參錯如交蛇。

translations.literal: Second year of Zhidao, second month, day bingzi, at night—in the west there were eight bands of bluish-white vapor long and short, like a broom-star's sweep, slightly passing through the River of Heaven, interwoven like crossing serpents.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day bingzi of the second month of the second year of the Zhidao era, eight bluish-white vapors of varying lengths appeared in the west like a comet's sweep, passed partway through the Milky Way, and interwove like crossing serpents.

sentences.zh: 咸平三年十月辛亥，黑氣貫北斗。

translations.literal: Third year of Xianping, tenth month, day xinhai—black vapor pierced the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai of the tenth month of the third year of the Xianping era, black vapor pierced the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，黑氣長三丈餘，貫心宿，入天市垣抵帝坐，久方散。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengwu—black vapor three zhang and more in length pierced the Heart lodge, entered the Celestial Market Enclosure reaching the Emperor's Seat, and only after a long time dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu of the twelfth month, black vapor more than three zhang long pierced the Heart, entered the Celestial Market Enclosure as far as the Emperor's Seat, and dispersed only after a long while.

sentences.zh: 四年三月丙申，白氣二，亙天。

translations.literal: Fourth year, third month, day bingshen—two white vapors spanned heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen of the third month of the fourth year, two white vapors stretched across the sky.

sentences.zh: 十月辛亥，黑氣貫北斗。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day xinhai—black vapor pierced the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai of the tenth month, black vapor pierced the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，白氣如虹貫日，久而散。

translations.literal: Fifth year, first month—white vapor like a rainbow pierced the sun, and after a long time dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year, white vapor like a rainbow pierced the sun and dispersed only after a long while.

sentences.zh: 七月戊戌，白氣如陣貫東井。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day wuxu—white vapor like a battle formation pierced the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu of the seventh month, white vapor shaped like a battle formation pierced the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 六年四月己巳，白氣東西亙天。

translations.literal: Sixth year, fourth month, day jisi—white vapor east and west spanned heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi of the fourth month of the sixth year, white vapor stretched east and west across the sky.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，白氣貫日。

translations.literal: Day dingchou—white vapor pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, white vapor pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥，白氣出昴，至東壁沒。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinhai—white vapor emerged from the Hairy Head, reaching the Eastern Wall and vanishing.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai of the fifth month, white vapor rose from the Hairy Head, reached the Eastern Wall, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，赤氣出貫天。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinwei—red vapor emerged and pierced heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei of the sixth month, red vapor rose and pierced through heaven.

sentences.zh: 丙子，白氣出河鼓左右旗，分爲數道沒。

translations.literal: Day bingzi—white vapor emerged from the left and right banners of the River Drum, divided into several bands and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, white vapor rose from the left and right banners of the Drum at the River, split into several bands, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 七月癸卯，白氣如彗，起西南。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day guimao—white vapor like a broom-star arose in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao of the seventh month, white vapor like a comet arose in the southwest.

sentences.zh: 景德元年三月，白氣貫軒轅，蒼白氣十餘如布亙天。

translations.literal: First year of Jingde, third month—white vapor pierced the Chariot; more than ten bluish-white vapors like cloth spanned heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of the Jingde era, white vapor pierced the Chariot, and more than ten bluish-white vapors like cloth stretched across the sky.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，白氣數道如芒帚，長七尺許。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yisi—several bands of white vapor like bristle-brooms, about seven chi long.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi of the fifth month, several bands of white vapor shaped like bristle-brooms appeared, each about seven feet long.

sentences.zh: 七月辛亥，黃氣出壁，長五丈餘。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day xinhai—yellow vapor emerged from the Wall, more than five zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai of the seventh month, yellow vapor rose from the Wall; it was more than five zhang long.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，黑氣十餘道沖日。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guichou—more than ten bands of black vapor struck the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou of the eleventh month, more than ten bands of black vapor struck the sun.

sentences.zh: 二年正月丙寅，黃白氣貫月，黑氣環之。

translations.literal: Second year, first month, day bingyin—yellow-white vapor pierced the moon, black vapor encircling it.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin of the first month of the second year, yellow-white vapor pierced the moon while black vapor encircled it.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，白氣五道貫北斗。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingchou—five bands of white vapor pierced the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou of the second month, five bands of white vapor pierced the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 十月丙子，白氣出閣道東西，孛孛有光。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day bingzi—white vapor emerged east and west of the Passage, bristling with light.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi of the tenth month, white vapor rose east and west of the Passage, bristling with light.

sentences.zh: 三年三月丙辰，北方赤氣亙天，白氣貫月。

translations.literal: Third year, third month, day bingchen—in the north red vapor spanned heaven, white vapor pierced the moon.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen of the third month of the third year, red vapor in the north stretched across the sky and white vapor pierced the moon.

sentences.zh: 四月癸卯，黃氣如柱貫月。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day guimao—yellow vapor like a pillar pierced the moon.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao of the fourth month, yellow vapor like a pillar pierced the moon.

sentences.zh: 十月甲午，黑氣貫北斗魁。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jiawu—black vapor pierced the Dipper's Lead.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu of the tenth month, black vapor pierced the lead of the Dipper.

sentences.zh: 四年三月己未，白氣東西亙天。

translations.literal: Fourth year, third month, day jiwei—white vapor east and west spanned heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei of the third month of the fourth year, white vapor stretched east and west across the sky.

sentences.zh: 庚申，白氣出南方，長一丈許，久而不散。

translations.literal: Day gengshen—white vapor emerged in the south, about one zhang long, long undispersed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen, white vapor rose in the south; it was about one zhang long and remained undispersed for a long time.

sentences.zh: 四月庚午，白氣貫北斗，長十丈。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day gengwu—white vapor pierced the Northern Dipper, ten zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu of the fourth month, white vapor ten zhang long pierced the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，白氣如布襲月，三丈許。

translations.literal: Day gengyin—white vapor like cloth descended upon the moon, about three zhang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin, white vapor like cloth enveloped the moon for about three zhang.

sentences.zh: 甲午，南方有黑氣貫心宿，長五丈許。

translations.literal: Day jiawu—in the south there was black vapor piercing the Heart lodge, about five zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu, black vapor about five zhang long in the south pierced the Heart.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，中天有赤氣如掃，長七尺，在輿鬼南。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jisi—at mid-heaven there was red vapor like sweeping, seven chi long, south of the Celestial Coach-and-Horses.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi of the eleventh month, red vapor at mid-heaven swept like a broom for seven feet, south of the Celestial Coach-and-Horses.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符元年正月癸亥朔，黃氣出於艮。

translations.literal: First year of Dazhong Xiangfu, first month, first day of the month guihai—yellow vapor emerged from the Gen direction.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of the first year of the Dazhong Xiangfu era, the day guihai, yellow vapor emerged from the northeast.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，白氣二，東西亙天。

translations.literal: Day dingchou—two white vapors east and west spanned heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, two white vapors stretched east and west across the sky.

sentences.zh: 七月，西北方白雲氣如彗帚三十餘條。

translations.literal: Seventh month—in the northwest white cloud-vapor like broom-comet, more than thirty strands.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, more than thirty strands of white cloud-vapor like comet-brooms appeared in the northwest.

sentences.zh: 二年九月戊午，黃氣如柱起東南方，長五丈許。

translations.literal: Second year, ninth month, day wuwu—yellow vapor like a pillar arose in the southeast, about five zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu of the ninth month of the second year, yellow vapor like a pillar rose in the southeast; it was about five zhang long.

sentences.zh: 三年四月丁巳，中天黑氣東西亙天。

translations.literal: Third year, fourth month, day dingsi—at mid-heaven black vapor east and west spanned heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi of the fourth month of the third year, black vapor at mid-heaven stretched east and west across the sky.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，青赤氣貫太微。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guihai—blue-red vapor pierced the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai of the twelfth month, blue-red vapor pierced the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 五年二月壬寅，白氣長五丈，出東井，貫北斗魁及軒轅。

translations.literal: Fifth year, second month, day renyin—white vapor five zhang long, emerging from the Eastern Well, piercing the Dipper's Lead and the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin of the second month of the fifth year, white vapor five zhang long rose from the Eastern Well and pierced the lead of the Dipper and the Chariot.

sentences.zh: 七年五月，有氣出紫微爲宮闕狀，光燭地。

translations.literal: Seventh year, fifth month—there was vapor emerging from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure in the shape of palace gates, its light illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventh year, vapor rose from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure in the shape of palace gates, and its light lit the ground.

sentences.zh: 天禧二年四月，黃氣如柱貫月。

translations.literal: Second year of Tianxi, fourth month—yellow vapor like a pillar pierced the moon.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of the Tianxi era, yellow vapor like a pillar pierced the moon.

sentences.zh: 天聖七年二月己卯夜，蒼黑雲長三十丈，貫弧矢、翼、軫。

translations.literal: Seventh year of Tiansheng, second month, day jimao, at night—bluish-black cloud thirty zhang long pierced Bow and Arrow, Wings, and Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day jimao of the second month of the seventh year of the Tiansheng era, a bluish-black cloud thirty zhang long pierced Bow and Arrow, the Wings, and the Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: 明道元年十月庚子夜，黃白氣五，貫紫微垣。

translations.literal: First year of Mingdao, tenth month, day gengzi, at night—five yellow-white vapors pierced the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day gengzi of the tenth month of the first year of the Mingdao era, five yellow-white vapors pierced the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬戌，西北有蒼白氣亙天。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renxu—in the northwest there was bluish-white vapor spanning heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu of the twelfth month, bluish-white vapor in the northwest stretched across the sky.

sentences.zh: 景祐元年八月壬戌，青黃白氣如彗，長七尺余，出張、翼之上，凡三十三日不見。

translations.literal: First year of Jingyou, eighth month, day renxu—blue, yellow, and white vapor like a broom-star, more than seven chi long, emerging above the Spread and Wings; for thirty-three days altogether it was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu of the eighth month of the first year of the Jingyou era, blue, yellow, and white vapor like a comet more than seven feet long appeared above the Spread and Wings and was not seen again after thirty-three days.

sentences.zh: 四年七月戊申夜，黑氣長丈余，出畢宿下。

translations.literal: Fourth year, seventh month, day wushen, at night—black vapor more than one zhang long emerged below the Net lodge.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day wushen of the seventh month of the fourth year, black vapor more than one zhang long rose below the Net.

sentences.zh: 寶元二年正月壬子夜，蒼黑雲起西北方，長三十尺，漸東南行，曆婁、胃、昴、畢及火、木，相次中天而散。

translations.literal: Second year of Baoyuan, first month, day renzi, at night—bluish-black cloud arose in the northwest, thirty chi long, gradually moving southeast, traversing Bond, Stomach, Hairy Head, Net, and Fire and Wood, successively reaching mid-heaven and dispersing.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day renzi of the first month of the second year of the Baoyuan era, a bluish-black cloud thirty feet long arose in the northwest, moved gradually southeast, passed Bond, Stomach, Hairy Head, Net, and Mars and Jupiter in turn, reached mid-heaven, and dispersed.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅夜，細黑雲起西北方，長三十丈，貫王良及營室。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiayin, at night—fine black cloud arose in the northwest, thirty zhang long, piercing Wang Liang and Encampment.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day jiayin of the third month, a fine black cloud thirty zhang long arose in the northwest and pierced Wang Liang and the Encampment.

sentences.zh: 康定元年三月丙子夜，東南方近濁，黑色橫亙數丈，闊尺許，良久散。

translations.literal: First year of Kangding, third month, day bingzi, at night—southeast near the Turbid, black color spanning horizontally several zhang, about one chi wide, after a long time dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day bingzi of the third month of the first year of the Kangding era, near the Turbid in the southeast a black band several zhang long and about one chi wide stretched horizontally and dispersed only after a long while.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，黑氣起心宿西，長五十丈，首尾侵濁，久之散。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renzi—black vapor arose west of the Heart lodge, fifty zhang long, its head and tail encroaching the Turbid, dispersing after a long time.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi of the sixth month, black vapor fifty zhang long rose west of the Heart; its head and tail reached into the Turbid and dispersed only after a long while.

sentences.zh: 慶曆元年八月庚辰夜，東方有白氣，長十尺許，在星宿度中，至十日，長丈餘，沖天相，居星宿大星南九十餘日沒。

translations.literal: First year of Qingli, eighth month, day gengchen, at night—in the east there was white vapor, about ten chi long, within the Star lodge's degree; by the tenth day it was more than one zhang long, striking the Celestial Prime Minister, dwelling south of the great star of the Star lodge, vanishing after more than ninety days.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day gengchen of the eighth month of the first year of the Qingli era, white vapor about ten feet long appeared in the east within the Star's degree; by the tenth day it was more than one zhang long, struck the Celestial Prime Minister, remained south of the Star's great star, and vanished after more than ninety days.

sentences.zh: 壬午夜，黑氣起西南，長七丈，貫危宿、羽林，入濁，至天津，良久散。

translations.literal: Day renwu, at night—black vapor arose in the southwest, seven zhang long, piercing the Rooftop lodge and Feathered Forest, entering the Turbid, reaching the Celestial Ford, dispersing after a long while.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day renwu, black vapor seven zhang long rose in the southwest, pierced the Rooftop and Feathered Forest, entered the Turbid, reached the Celestial Ford, and dispersed only after a long while.

sentences.zh: 癸卯夜，蒼白雲起西北，闊二尺許，首尾至濁，良久沒。

translations.literal: Day guimao, at night—bluish-white cloud arose in the northwest, about two chi wide, head and tail reaching the Turbid, after a long while vanishing.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day guimao, bluish-white cloud about two feet wide arose in the northwest, its head and tail reaching the Turbid, and vanished only after a long while.

sentences.zh: 二年十一月壬申，黑氣貫北斗柄。

translations.literal: Second year, eleventh month, day renshen—black vapor pierced the Handle of the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen of the eleventh month of the second year, black vapor pierced the handle of the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申，白雲貫北斗。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiashen—white cloud pierced the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen of the eighth month, white cloud pierced the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 三年正月戊戌，中天有白氣，長二十丈，向西南行，貫日。

translations.literal: Third year, first month, day wuxu—at mid-heaven there was white vapor, twenty zhang long, moving toward the southwest, piercing the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu of the first month of the third year, white vapor at mid-heaven twenty zhang long moved southwestward and pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 四月癸卯，白氣二，生西北隅，上中天，首尾至濁，東南行，良久散。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day guimao—two white vapors, arising at the northwest corner, reaching mid-heaven, head and tail to the Turbid, moving southeast, dispersing after a long while.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao of the fourth month, two white vapors arose in the northwest, reached mid-heaven with head and tail extending to the Turbid, moved southeastward, and dispersed only after a long while.

sentences.zh: 七月戊辰，西南生黑氣，長三丈許，經天而散。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day wuchen—in the southwest black vapor arose, about three zhang long, passing through heaven and dispersing.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen of the seventh month, black vapor about three zhang long arose in the southwest, passed across the sky, and dispersed.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子夜，白氣貫北斗魁。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renzi, at night—white vapor pierced the Dipper's Lead.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day renzi of the eighth month, white vapor pierced the lead of the Dipper.

sentences.zh: 四年五月甲子夜，黑氣起東北方，近濁，長五丈許，良久散。

translations.literal: Fourth year, fifth month, day jiazi, at night—black vapor arose in the northeast, near the Turbid, about five zhang long, dispersing after a long while.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day jiazi of the fifth month of the fourth year, black vapor about five zhang long rose in the northeast near the Turbid and dispersed only after a long while.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳夜，中天有氣長二丈許，貫捲舌、南河東北，少頃散。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinsi, at night—at mid-heaven there was vapor about two zhang long, piercing Rolled Tongue and northeast of the South River, dispersing shortly after.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day xinsi of the ninth month, vapor at mid-heaven about two zhang long pierced Rolled Tongue and northeast of the South River and dispersed shortly afterward.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子夜，蒼白雲起，南近濁，久方散。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiazi, at night—bluish-white cloud arose, south near the Turbid, dispersing only after a long time.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day jiazi of the eleventh month, bluish-white cloud arose near the Turbid in the south and dispersed only after a long while.

sentences.zh: 八年正月丁酉夜，黑氣生，首尾至濁，漸東行，久之乃散。

translations.literal: Eighth year, first month, day dingyou, at night—black vapor arose, head and tail to the Turbid, gradually moving east, dispersing only after a long time.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day dingyou of the first month of the eighth year, black vapor arose with head and tail reaching the Turbid, moved gradually eastward, and dispersed only after a long while.

sentences.zh: 二月辛卯夜，西方近濁生黑氣，長三丈，良久散。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinmao, at night—in the west near the Turbid black vapor arose, three zhang long, dispersing after a long while.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day xinmao of the second month, black vapor three zhang long arose in the west near the Turbid and dispersed only after a long while.

sentences.zh: 皇祐四年十一月壬寅夜，黑氣生東方，南北至濁，貫參宿、軒轅。

translations.literal: Fourth year of Huangyou, eleventh month, day renyin, at night—black vapor arose in the east, north and south to the Turbid, piercing the Triaster lodge and the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day renyin of the eleventh month of the fourth year of the Huangyou era, black vapor arose in the east with its north and south ends reaching the Turbid and pierced the Triaster and the Chariot.

sentences.zh: 辛酉夜，白氣起北方，近濁，長五丈許，曆北斗，久之散。

translations.literal: Day xinyou, at night—white vapor arose in the north, near the Turbid, about five zhang long, traversing the Northern Dipper, dispersing after a long time.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day xinyou, white vapor about five zhang long rose in the north near the Turbid, passed through the Northern Dipper, and dispersed only after a long while.

sentences.zh: 治平元年六月戊午夜，蒼白雲起東北方，長一丈許，貫畢。

translations.literal: First year of Zhiping, sixth month, day wuwu, at night—bluish-white cloud arose in the northeast, about one zhang long, piercing the Net.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day wuwu of the sixth month of the first year of the Zhiping era, bluish-white cloud about one zhang long rose in the northeast and pierced the Net.

sentences.zh: 二年二月乙未夜，蒼黑雲起西北方，長五丈許，貫東井及北斗，良久散。

translations.literal: Second year, second month, day yiwei, at night—bluish-black cloud arose in the northwest, about five zhang long, piercing the Eastern Well and Northern Dipper, dispersing after a long while.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day yiwei of the second month of the second year, a bluish-black cloud about five zhang long arose in the northwest, pierced the Eastern Well and the Northern Dipper, and dispersed only after a long while.

sentences.zh: 四月癸巳夜，蒼黑雲起西北方，長三十尺，西至軒轅大民，北抵鉤陳。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day guisi, at night—bluish-black cloud arose in the northwest, thirty chi long, west reaching the Chariot's Great People, north reaching the Arrayed Halberds.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day guisi of the fourth month, a bluish-black cloud thirty feet long arose in the northwest, extended west to the Chariot's Great People, and reached north as far as the Arrayed Halberds.

sentences.zh: 丙午夜，西北方有白氣，漸東南行，首尾至濁，貫角宿，移西北，久方散。

translations.literal: Day bingwu, at night—in the northwest there was white vapor, gradually moving southeast, head and tail to the Turbid, piercing the Horn lodge, shifting northwest, dispersing only after a long time.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day bingwu, white vapor in the northwest moved gradually southeast with head and tail reaching the Turbid, pierced the Horn, shifted northwestward, and dispersed only after a long while.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申夜，西北蒼黑雲長三丈許，貫營室壁壘陣及天河。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengshen, at night—in the northwest bluish-black cloud about three zhang long pierced Encampment, Wall-and-Rampart Formation, and the River of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day gengshen of the ninth month, bluish-black cloud about three zhang long in the northwest pierced the Encampment, the Wall and Rampart Formation, and the Milky Way.

sentences.zh: 三年六月丁未夜，東方有蒼白雲，長一丈許，貫畢。

translations.literal: Third year, sixth month, day dingwei, at night—in the east there was bluish-white cloud, about one zhang long, piercing the Net.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day dingwei of the sixth month of the third year, bluish-white cloud about one zhang long in the east pierced the Net.

sentences.zh: 四年二月癸巳夜，蒼白雲起南方，長三丈，闊尺，貫南門星。

translations.literal: Fourth year, second month, day guisi, at night—bluish-white cloud arose in the south, three zhang long, one chi wide, piercing the Southern Gate star.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day guisi of the second month of the fourth year, bluish-white cloud three zhang long and one chi wide rose in the south and pierced the Southern Gate star.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅夜，西南方起蒼白雲二，長三丈，闊尺，相距二尺，貫東井南河，久之乃散。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiayin, at night—in the southwest arose two bluish-white clouds, three zhang long, one chi wide, two chi apart, piercing the Eastern Well and South River, dispersing only after a long time.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day jiayin of the third month, two bluish-white clouds three zhang long and one chi wide rose in the southwest two feet apart, pierced the Eastern Well and South River, and dispersed only after a long while.

sentences.zh: 閏三月辛巳夜，蒼黑雲起南方，兩首至濁，闊尺，貫尾、箕、鬥、牛、庫樓、騎官。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, day xinsi, at night—bluish-black cloud arose in the south, both ends to the Turbid, one chi wide, piercing Tail, Winnowing Basket, Dipper, Ox, Arsenal Tower, and Cavalry Officer.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day xinsi of the intercalary third month, bluish-black cloud one chi wide rose in the south with both ends reaching the Turbid and pierced the Tail, Winnowing Basket, Dipper, Ox, Arsenal Tower, and Cavalry Officer.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅夜，蒼黑雲起北方，長三丈，闊尺，貫紫微垣、王良。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuyin, at night—bluish-black cloud arose in the north, three zhang long, one chi wide, piercing the Purple Forbidden Enclosure and Wang Liang.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day wuyin of the fifth month, bluish-black cloud three zhang long and one chi wide rose in the north and pierced the Purple Forbidden Enclosure and Wang Liang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅夜，蒼黑雲起北方，長三丈，闊尺，貫紫微垣。

translations.literal: Day renyin, at night—blue-black cloud arose in the north, three zhang long, one chi wide, piercing the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day renyin, blue-black cloud three zhang long and one chi wide rose in the north and pierced the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 甲辰夜，蒼黑雲起東方，長丈，闊尺，貫天苑、五車、參旗。

translations.literal: Day jiachen, at night—blue-black cloud arose in the east, one zhang long, one chi wide, piercing the Celestial Meadows, Five Chariots, and Banner of Three Stars.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day jiachen, blue-black cloud one zhang long and one chi wide rose in the east and pierced the Celestial Meadows, Five Chariots, and Banner of Three Stars.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥夜，白雲起東北方，長五丈，上闊下狹，貫天船、閣道、傳舍、紫微垣、天棓。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guihai, at night—white cloud arose in the northeast, five zhang long, broad above and narrow below, piercing the Celestial Boat, Flying Corridor, Guest House, Purple Forbidden Enclosure, and Celestial Flail.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day guihai of the sixth month, white cloud five zhang long, broad at the top and narrow at the bottom, rose in the northeast and pierced the Celestial Boat, Flying Corridor, Guest House, Purple Forbidden Enclosure, and Celestial Flail.

sentences.zh: 戊辰夜，黑雲起北方，長三丈，闊尺，貫北斗、紫微垣、王良。

translations.literal: Day wuchen, at night—black cloud arose in the north, three zhang long, one chi wide, piercing the Northern Dipper, Purple Forbidden Enclosure, and Wang Liang.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day wuchen, black cloud three zhang long and one chi wide rose in the north and pierced the Northern Dipper, Purple Forbidden Enclosure, and Wang Liang.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥夜，黑氣起西北方，長丈，闊尺，貫北斗。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yihai, at night—black vapor arose in the northwest, one zhang long, one chi wide, piercing the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day yihai of the eighth month, black vapor one zhang long and one chi wide rose in the northwest and pierced the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 十月庚申夜，黃氣一，上下貫月中。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day gengshen, at night—one band of yellow vapor, above and below piercing through the moon.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day gengshen of the tenth month, a band of yellow vapor pierced through the moon from above and below.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子夜，蒼黑氣起南方，長五丈，闊二尺，東至庫樓，北至南河，橫貫翼。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingzi, at night—blue-black vapor arose in the south, five zhang long, two chi wide, east reaching the Arsenal Tower, north reaching the South River, horizontally piercing the Wings.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day bingzi of the eleventh month, blue-black vapor five zhang long and two chi wide rose in the south, extended east to the Arsenal Tower and north to the South River, and horizontally pierced the Wings.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌夜，蒼黑雲起南方，長三丈，闊二尺，貫五車、東井、五諸侯。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengxu, at night—blue-black cloud arose in the south, three zhang long, two chi wide, piercing the Five Chariots, Eastern Well, and Five Feudal Lords.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day gengxu of the twelfth month, blue-black cloud three zhang long and two chi wide rose in the south and pierced the Five Chariots, Eastern Well, and Five Feudal Lords.

sentences.zh: 熙甯元年正月乙酉夜，蒼白雲起西南方，長四丈，闊尺，貫月及南河、輿鬼、軒轅。

translations.literal: First year of the Xining era, first month, day yiyou, at night—pale cloud arose in the southwest, four zhang long, one chi wide, piercing the moon and the South River, Ghost Carriage, and Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day yiyou of the first month of the first year of the Xining era, pale cloud four zhang long and one chi wide rose in the southwest and pierced the moon, the South River, Ghost Carriage, and Chariot.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉夜，蒼黑雲起北方，長二丈，闊尺，貫北斗魁，東貫文昌。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiyou, at night—blue-black cloud arose in the north, two zhang long, one chi wide, piercing the lead of the Northern Dipper, and east piercing Wenchang.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day jiyou of the sixth month, blue-black cloud two zhang long and one chi wide rose in the north, pierced the lead of the Northern Dipper, and extended east through Wenchang.

sentences.zh: 十月庚申夜，蒼黑雲起北方，東西兩首至濁，貫織女、天棓、紫微垣、北斗魁。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day gengshen, at night—blue-black cloud arose in the north, both ends east and west reaching the Turbid, piercing the Weaver Girl, Celestial Flail, Purple Forbidden Enclosure, and lead of the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day gengshen of the tenth month, blue-black cloud rose in the north with both ends reaching the Turbid east and west and pierced the Weaver Girl, Celestial Flail, Purple Forbidden Enclosure, and lead of the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 二年四月甲辰夜，蒼白雲起東南方，長三丈，闊尺，貫天市垣。

translations.literal: Second year, fourth month, day jiachen, at night—pale cloud arose in the southeast, three zhang long, one chi wide, piercing the Celestial Market Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day jiachen of the fourth month of the second year, pale cloud three zhang long and one chi wide rose in the southeast and pierced the Celestial Market Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉夜，蒼黑雲起西南方，長四丈，闊二尺，貫大角、左右攝提、天市垣、鬥、女、牛。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinyou, at night—blue-black cloud arose in the southwest, four zhang long, two chi wide, piercing the Great Horn, Left and Right Leadings, Celestial Market Enclosure, Dipper, Maid, and Ox.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day xinyou of the sixth month, blue-black cloud four zhang long and two chi wide rose in the southwest and pierced the Great Horn, Left and Right Leadings, Celestial Market Enclosure, Dipper, Maid, and Ox.

sentences.zh: 七月甲申，日下有五色雲。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day jiashen—below the sun there were five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen of the seventh month, five-colored clouds appeared below the sun.

sentences.zh: 十一月，每夕有赤氣見西北隅，如火，至人定乃滅。

translations.literal: Eleventh month—each evening red vapor appeared in the northwest corner, like fire, vanishing only at the second watch of night.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the eleventh month, red vapor like fire appeared each evening in the northwest corner and did not vanish until the second watch of night (~9–11 p.m.).

sentences.zh: 三年二月庚申夜，蒼黑雲起西北方，長三丈，闊二尺，貫王良、扶箱、天廚。

translations.literal: Third year, second month, day gengshen, at night—blue-black cloud arose in the northwest, three zhang long, two chi wide, piercing Wang Liang, Supporting Box, and Celestial Kitchen.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day gengshen of the second month of the third year, blue-black cloud three zhang long and two chi wide rose in the northwest and pierced Wang Liang, Supporting Box, and Celestial Kitchen.

sentences.zh: 六月己未夜，蒼黑雲起西北方，長丈，闊尺，貫五車。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiwei, at night—blue-black cloud arose in the northwest, one zhang long, one chi wide, piercing the Five Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day jiwei of the sixth month, blue-black cloud one zhang long and one chi wide rose in the northwest and pierced the Five Chariots.

sentences.zh: 又起西北，長丈餘，貫北斗魁、文昌。

translations.literal: Again it arose in the northwest, more than one zhang long, piercing the lead of the Northern Dipper and Wenchang.
translations.idiomatic: Again cloud arose in the northwest, more than one zhang long, and pierced the lead of the Northern Dipper and Wenchang.

sentences.zh: 五年七月丁亥夜，白雲起南方，長丈，貫氐、房、心。

translations.literal: Fifth year, seventh month, day dinghai, at night—white cloud arose in the south, one zhang long, piercing the Root, Room, and Heart.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day dinghai of the seventh month of the fifth year, white cloud one zhang long rose in the south and pierced the Root, Room, and Heart.

sentences.zh: 六年五月庚申夜，蒼黑雲起東北方，長五丈，闊二尺，貫雲雨、閣道。

translations.literal: Sixth year, fifth month, day gengshen, at night—blue-black cloud arose in the northeast, five zhang long, two chi wide, piercing Cloud and Rain and the Flying Corridor.
translations.idiomatic: At night on the day gengshen of the fifth month of the sixth year, blue-black cloud five zhang long and two chi wide rose in the northeast and pierced Cloud and Rain and the Flying Corridor.

sentences.zh: 七年三月壬子，蒼白雲起西南方，長二丈，闊尺，貫日，經中天過，白氣如帶。

translations.literal: Seventh year, third month, day renzi—pale cloud arose in the southwest, two zhang long, one chi wide, piercing the sun, passing through mid-heaven, white vapor like a belt.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi of the third month of the seventh year, pale cloud two zhang long and one chi wide rose in the southwest, pierced the sun, passed through mid-heaven, and white vapor appeared like a belt.

sentences.zh: 四月壬申夜，蒼白雲起北方，長五丈，闊二尺，貫北斗魁、鉤陳、王良、閣道，東至奎。

sentences.zh: 二十七年二月乙酉，赤氣出紫微垣。

translations.literal: Twenty-seventh year, second month, day yiyou—red vapor emerged from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou of the second month of the twenty-seventh year, red vapor emerged from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 十月壬寅，赤氣隨日出。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day renyin—red vapor followed the sun as it rose.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin of the tenth month, red vapor followed the sun as it rose.

sentences.zh: 三十年正月壬申，東北方赤氣一帶五處如火影。

translations.literal: Thirtieth year, first month, day renshen—northeast red vapor in one belt at five places like fire shadows.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen of the first month of the thirtieth year, red vapor in one belt at five places in the northeast appeared like fire shadows.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，西南方白氣自尾曆壁、婁、昴宿。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiawu—southwest white vapor from the Tail passed through the lodges Wall, Bond, Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu of the eleventh month, white vapor in the southwest passed from the Tail lodge through Wall, Bond, and Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，其夜白氣出尾宿，曆心、房、氐、亢、角，入天市，貫太微，至郎位止，有類天漢。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wushen—that night white vapor emerged from the Tail lodge, passed through Heart, Room, Root, Neck, and Horn, entered the Celestial Market, pierced the Supreme Palace Enclosure, stopping at the Courtier's Seat, resembling the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: That night on the day wushen of the twelfth month, white vapor emerged from the Tail lodge, passed through Heart, Room, Root, Neck, and Horn, entered the Celestial Market, pierced the Supreme Palace Enclosure, stopped at the Courtier's Seat, and resembled the Celestial River (Milky Way).

sentences.zh: 三十一年十二月辛丑，其夜，白氣出鬥宿，曆牛、女、危，至婁止，約廣六丈，類天漢，東西亙天。

translations.literal: Thirty-first year, twelfth month, day xinchou—that night, white vapor emerged from the Dipper lodge, passed through Ox, Maid, and Rooftop, stopping at Bond, about six zhang wide, resembling the Celestial River, east and west spanning heaven.
translations.idiomatic: That night on the day xinchou of the twelfth month of the thirty-first year, white vapor emerged from the Dipper lodge, passed through Ox, Maid, and Rooftop, and stopped at Bond; it was about six zhang wide, resembled the Celestial River (Milky Way), and stretched east and west across the sky.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年十二月壬午，其夜，白氣出危宿，曆室、壁、奎、胃、婁至昴止。

translations.literal: First year of the Longxing era, twelfth month, day renwu—that night, white vapor emerged from the Rooftop lodge, passed through Encampment, Wall, Strider, Stomach, and Bond, stopping at Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: That night on the day renwu of the twelfth month of the first year of the Longxing era, white vapor emerged from the Rooftop lodge, passed through Encampment, Wall, Strider, Stomach, and Bond, and stopped at Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 二年十一月庚寅，其日，赤雲氣遍天，隨日入。

translations.literal: Second year, eleventh month, day gengyin—that day, red cloud vapor filled the sky, following the sun as it set.
translations.idiomatic: That day on the day gengyin of the eleventh month of the second year, red cloud vapor filled the sky and followed the sun as it set.

sentences.zh: 乾道元年正月庚午，其夜，白氣出奎宿，漸上，經婁、胃、昴，貫畢，入參宿內止。

translations.literal: First year of the Qiandao era, first month, day gengwu—that night, white vapor emerged from the Strider lodge, gradually rising, passing through Bond, Stomach, and Hairy Head, piercing the Net, stopping within the Triaster lodge.
translations.idiomatic: That night on the day gengwu of the first month of the first year of the Qiandao era, white vapor emerged from the Strider lodge, gradually rose, passed through Bond, Stomach, and Hairy Head, pierced the Net, and stopped within the Triaster lodge.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，其夜，白氣自參宿至角宿止，與天漢相接，約廣七丈。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuchen—that night, white vapor from the Triaster lodge to the Horn lodge stopped, connecting with the Celestial River, about seven zhang wide.
translations.idiomatic: That night on the day wuchen of the third month, white vapor from the Triaster lodge to the Horn lodge stopped, connected with the Celestial River, and was about seven zhang wide.

sentences.zh: 四月丁酉，其夜，蒼白氣自西北漸上，東北入天市垣；

translations.literal: Fourth month, day dingyou—that night, pale vapor gradually rose from the northwest, entering the Celestial Market Enclosure in the northeast;
translations.idiomatic: That night on the day dingyou of the fourth month, pale vapor gradually rose from the northwest and entered the Celestial Market Enclosure in the northeast;

sentences.zh: 辛丑，入北斗魁中及入文昌星；

translations.literal: Day xinchou—entered the lead of the Northern Dipper and entered Wenchang star;
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou, it entered the lead of the Northern Dipper and entered Wenchang star;

sentences.zh: 乙巳，入紫微垣內至北極、天樞中。

translations.literal: Day yisi—entered within the Purple Forbidden Enclosure reaching the North Pole and Celestial Pivot.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi, it entered within the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, reaching the North Pole and Celestial Pivot.

sentences.zh: 十月己丑，蒼白雲氣長二丈，穿入翼宿。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jichou—pale cloud vapor two zhang long, piercing into the Wings lodge.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou of the tenth month, pale cloud vapor two zhang long pierced into the Wings lodge.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，白氣出女宿，曆虛、危、室、壁、奎、婁、胃宿，入昴宿止。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingyin—white vapor emerged from the Maid lodge, passed through Emptiness, Rooftop, Encampment, Wall, Strider, Bond, and Stomach lodges, stopping at Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin of the eleventh month, white vapor emerged from the Maid lodge, passed through Emptiness, Rooftop, Encampment, Wall, Strider, Bond, and Stomach lodges, and stopped at Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 二年十二月庚子，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: Second year, twelfth month, day gengzi—white vapor spanned heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi of the twelfth month of the second year, white vapor stretched across the sky.

sentences.zh: 六年十月庚午，赤氣隨日出。

translations.literal: Sixth year, tenth month, day gengwu—red vapor followed the sun as it rose.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu of the tenth month of the sixth year, red vapor followed the sun as it rose.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，赤氣隨日入。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingchou—red vapor followed the sun as it set.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day dingchou, red vapor accompanied the sun as it set.

sentences.zh: 七年七月壬寅，赤氣隨日入。

translations.literal: Seventh year, seventh month, day renyin—red vapor followed the sun as it set.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the seventh year, on the day renyin, red vapor accompanied the sun as it set.

sentences.zh: 十月己未，赤氣隨日出。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jiwei—red vapor followed the sun as it rose.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day jiwei, red vapor accompanied the sun as it rose.

sentences.zh: 八年十月乙巳，赤氣隨日入；

translations.literal: Eighth year, tenth month, day yisi—red vapor followed the sun as it set;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the eighth year, on the day yisi, red vapor accompanied the sun as it set;

sentences.zh: 丙午，隨日出。

translations.literal: Day bingwu—it followed the sun as it rose.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu it accompanied the sun as it rose.

sentences.zh: 九年十月壬申，其日，矞雲見。

translations.literal: Ninth year, tenth month, day renshen—on that day, auspicious cloud appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the ninth year, on the day renshen, an auspicious cloud was seen.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年十月戊寅，東北方生曲虹。

translations.literal: First year of Chunxi, tenth month, day wuyin—a curved rainbow arose in the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of the Chunxi era, on the day wuyin, a curved rainbow appeared in the northeast.

sentences.zh: 三年八月丁酉，赤氣隨日入；

translations.literal: Third year, eighth month, day dingyou—red vapor followed the sun as it set;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year, on the day dingyou, red vapor accompanied the sun as it set;

sentences.zh: 戊戌，隨日出。

translations.literal: Day wuxu—it followed the sun as it rose.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu it accompanied the sun as it rose.

sentences.zh: 五年十月丁巳，生曲虹。

translations.literal: Fifth year, tenth month, day dingsi—a curved rainbow arose.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fifth year, on the day dingsi, a curved rainbow appeared.

sentences.zh: 十年正月戊子，西南有白氣，如天漢而明，南北廣六丈，東西亙天。

translations.literal: Tenth year, first month, day wuzi—in the southwest there was white vapor, bright like the Celestial River, six zhang wide north to south, spanning heaven east to west.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year, on the day wuzi, white vapor appeared in the southwest, bright like the Milky Way, about sixty feet wide from north to south and stretching across the sky from east to west.

sentences.zh: 十四年十一月甲寅，赤氣隨日入。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, eleventh month, day jiayin—red vapor followed the sun as it set.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fourteenth year, on the day jiayin, red vapor accompanied the sun as it set.

sentences.zh: 紹熙四年十一月甲戌夜，赤雲、白氣見。

translations.literal: Fourth year of Shaoxi, eleventh month, night of day jiaxu—red cloud and white vapor were seen.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the day jiaxu in the eleventh month of the fourth year of the Shaoxi era, red cloud and white vapor appeared.

sentences.zh: 五年六月壬寅，白敢如帶亙天；

translations.literal: Fifth year, sixth month, day renyin—white vapor like a belt spanned heaven;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifth year, on the day renyin, white vapor like a belt stretched across the sky;

sentences.zh: 己酉，又如之。

translations.literal: Day jiyou—it was again like this.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou the same phenomenon appeared again.

sentences.zh: 慶元四年八月庚辰，白氣如帶亙天。

translations.literal: Fourth year of Qingyuan, eighth month, day gengchen—white vapor like a belt spanned heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year of the Qingyuan era, on the day gengchen, white vapor like a belt stretched across the sky.

sentences.zh: 五年二月癸酉夜，白氣如帶亙天，八月癸亥，又如之。

translations.literal: Fifth year, second month, night of day guiyou—white vapor like a belt spanned heaven; eighth month, day guihai—it was again like this.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the day guiyou in the second month of the fifth year, white vapor like a belt stretched across the sky; in the eighth month, on the day guihai, the same phenomenon appeared again.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰四年二月庚申，赤氣亙天。

translations.literal: Fourth year of Jiatai, second month, day gengshen—red vapor spanned heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year of the Jiatai era, on the day gengshen, red vapor stretched across the sky.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，其日，白氣如帶亙天。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renshen—on that day, white vapor like a belt spanned heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day renshen, white vapor like a belt stretched across the sky.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，虹見。

translations.literal: Day guiyou—a rainbow was seen.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou a rainbow appeared.

sentences.zh: 嘉定六年十月乙卯，赤氣隨日出；

translations.literal: Sixth year of Jiading, tenth month, day yimao—red vapor followed the sun as it rose;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the sixth year of the Jiading era, on the day yimao, red vapor accompanied the sun as it rose;

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，隨日入。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinmao—it followed the sun as it set.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day xinmao, it accompanied the sun as it set.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙四年二月丙辰，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: Fourth year of Jiaxi, second month, day bingchen—white vapor spanned heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year of the Jiaxi era, on the day bingchen, white vapor stretched across the sky.

sentences.zh: 淳祐二年二月癸丑朔，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: Second year of Chunyou, first day of the second month guichou—white vapor spanned heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month of the second year of the Chunyou era, the day guichou, white vapor stretched across the sky.

sentences.zh: 十年十一月丁丑，虹見。

translations.literal: Tenth year, eleventh month, day dingchou—a rainbow was seen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the tenth year, on the day dingchou, a rainbow appeared.

sentences.zh: 景定三年七月甲申夜，白氣亙天，如匹布。

translations.literal: Third year of Jingding, seventh month, night of day jiashen—white vapor spanned heaven, like a bolt of cloth.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the day jiashen in the seventh month of the third year of the Jingding era, white vapor stretched across the sky like a bolt of cloth.
